jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
At Avsar Construction Development, Inc., we are passionate about delivering high-quality, sustainable construction solutions that create a positive impact on both communities and the environment. Guided by the belief that safe and reliable shelter is a fundamental human need, we approach every project with a focus on innovation, responsibility, and long-term value.

While we are a growing company, our foundation is built on the extensive experience and expertise of seasoned construction professionals. Their diverse industry backgrounds and hands-on knowledge help us deliver the quality, service, and reliability clients expect, while maintaining the flexibility and forward-thinking mindset of a growing organization. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to raising the standard of excellence in construction and building a better future for the communities we serve.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an **Asset & Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)** to support furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) coordination, procurement, and relocation activities across multiple educational facilities and construction projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) selection, specification, procurement, purchasing, and installation activities.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment requirements for new construction, renovation, and temporary swing-space projects.
* Assist with developing furniture and equipment inventories and identifying additional items required for project completion.
* Support procurement activities, including vendor coordination, bid reviews, purchasing, and tracking of orders.
* Monitor FF&E and relocation budgets, schedules, deliveries, and installation progress.
* Coordinate with project managers, architects, interior designers, facility representatives, vendors, and end users to plan furniture layouts and relocation activities.
* Assist in preparing scopes of work for movers and specialty contractors when required.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment deliveries, onsite installations, pre-move preparations, and post-move activities.
* Provide on-site oversight during relocation and installation activities to ensure work is completed according to project requirements.
* Assist with punch-list inspections, issue resolution, and final closeout activities.
* Coordinate asset tagging, inventory tracking, and disposition requirements.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, including purchase orders, proposals, delivery records, invoices, shipping documents, and related correspondence.
* Ensure assigned areas are properly prepared, accessible, and secured during relocation and installation activities.

### **Requirements**

**Required Experience**

* At least **1 year** of relevant experience in **interior design, construction, engineering, facilities management, furniture and equipment coordination, procurement, or relocation/move management**.

**Required Skills**

* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings and furniture layouts.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement processes.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office** applications, including **Word** and **Excel**.
* Ability to work on-site at multiple project locations.

**Required Education**

* High school diploma.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree** in **Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field**.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or asset management.
* Previous experience working on public works or institutional construction projects.
* Knowledge/proficiency in **AutoCAD**.
* Relevant professional certifications or memberships, such as **CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA**, or **LEED**.

### **What We Offer**

Finding the right workplace can make all the difference. That's why fostering a positive team environment, encouraging professional growth, and recognizing the value of every employee remain a priority as the company continues to grow.

**401(k) Retirement Plan**

Invest in your future with a retirement savings plan designed to help you achieve your long-term financial goals.

**Comprehensive Health Benefits**

Access medical, dental, and vision coverage to support your health and well-being, both on and off the job.

**Paid Time Off (PTO)**

Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work with generous paid time off.

**Professional Growth Opportunities**

Expand your skills, gain valuable industry experience, and advance your career through meaningful project involvement and continuous learning.

**A Supportive Team Environment**

Work alongside experienced professionals who value collaboration, encourage new ideas, and recognize your contributions.

**Join Us**

If you're looking for an opportunity to make an impact, grow your career, and be part of a team that is building a better future, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to welcoming talented and passionate individuals to the Avsar Construction team.

**Application Process & What to Expect**

Thank you for your interest in Avsar Construction Development! We're glad you're considering joining our team.

Please submit **one application per position** through the official LinkedIn or Lever application link. To help us keep the process organized and ensure every application receives proper consideration, materials sent directly to employees by email, text, or social media will not be reviewed unless requested by HR.

**What to Expect**

* **Application Review –** We’ll review your application and experience.

jobs.title: Production Assistant & Branded Live Ops Coordinator (TikTok Shop)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Platinum Commerce, LLC is a leading e-commerce and social commerce agency that partners with top-tier brands to accelerate their growth on TikTok Shop, Amazon, Walmart, and other digital marketplaces. As a certified TikTok Shop Partner (TSP), we provide end-to-end solutions including shop management, affiliate marketing, live streaming operations, content strategy, and fulfillment services. Our team of e-commerce experts has driven millions in GMV for our clients, working with brands across beauty, consumer electronics, fashion, health & wellness, and home goods.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a hands-on Production Assistant who can run the technical side of our live shopping streams and also keep the operation organized behind the scenes. You’ll set up, run, and troubleshoot live broadcasts across TikTok Shop. You’ll also manage stream schedules and own the run of show for each session, working closely with our Head of Live Commerce, hosts, account managers, and our Live Ops team. This role is ideal for someone who understands what it takes to make a branded live stream happen.

**Responsibilities**

**Live Production**

* Set up and break down live streaming equipment (cameras, lighting, audio, capture devices) for each session
* Run live production during streams, including camera operation, switching, audio levels, and on-screen product and graphics support
* Create TikTok LIVE sticker overlays and on-screen graphics (promo callouts, pricing, flash deals, countdowns) and implement them into the stream through TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS, or similar tools
* Monitor stream health in real time and troubleshoot technical issues as they arise
* Manage product staging and on-set organization so items are ready for each segment

**Scheduling**

* Build and maintain the live stream calendar across brands and platforms
* Schedule hosts and production crew for each session and handle last-minute changes or call-outs

**Run of Show & Stream Coordination**

* Build and maintain the run of show for each stream, including segments, product order, promos, and timing
* Coordinate with hosts, producers, account managers, and brand partners before each stream so everyone is aligned on the plan
* Keep the stream on track in real time, cueing hosts and adjusting the run of show as needed
* Confirm products, samples, and overlay assets are ready before going live

**Requirements**

* Background in live streaming or live commerce production, with direct TikTok Shop LIVE experience required (eBay Live or Whatnot experience is a plus)
* Hands-on experience creating and adding sticker overlays and on-screen graphics to TikTok LIVE streams
* Comfortable operating streaming and production equipment (cameras, switchers, mics, lighting)
* Experience managing schedules or coordinating live productions with multiple people
* Highly organized with strong follow-through and clear communication
* Calm under pressure and able to multitask during live, real-time broadcasts
* Reliable availability for scheduled shifts, including occasional evenings or weekends
* Detail-oriented, punctual, and able to take direction quickly in a fast-paced environment

**Location:** Beverly Hills, CA

**Pay:** $30.00 - $48.00 per hour

Pay: $30.00 - $48.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* Do you have prior experience with live commerce platforms (TikTok Shop, eBay Live, Whatnot, etc.)?

jobs.title: Retail Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**UR MISSION**

Nickey Kehoe is committed to building a category-defining and enduring company and culture. We believe in creating a sanctuary from chaos by creating spaces that are grounding and beautiful.

**OUR VALUES**

We believe in the necessity and value of a diverse and inclusive work environment, where employees are celebrated for their unique perspectives and our differences are seen as an opportunity to learn and grow.

We aspire to build a team of long-tenured, successful employees who love what they do. They work hard, are passionate about the company and their role, are enthusiastic collaborators with teammates, have high personal standards for excellence and accomplish important work.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Retail Operations Coordinator keeps Nickey Kehoe’s designated retail and office locations functional, supplied, and equipped for daily operations. Reporting to the Senior Retail Operations Manager, this role coordinates facilities maintenance, supply purchasing, everyday technology support, and routine operational reporting. The coordinator answers basic system questions using established standard operating procedures (SOPs), helps employees resolve routine issues, and follows through with service providers when additional support is needed.

**DUTIES INCLUDE**

**Facilities and Maintenance**

* Proactively identify maintenance needs and coordinate preventive service and repairs for building systems, fixtures, and equipment at assigned locations.
* Support landlord coordination as directed by the Senior Retail Operations Manager or Director of Operations, including relaying routine updates and arranging access for service visits
* Obtain quotes, schedule approved vendors, coordinate site access, and confirm work is complete while limiting disruption to store and office activities.
* Maintain service schedules, vendor contacts, warranties, repair histories, and open requests. Escalate urgent conditions and costs outside approved authority.
* Support assigned installations and workplace improvement projects under the direction of the Senior Retail Operations Manager.
* Coordinate workspace setup and seating changes as headcount grows, including arranging furniture, equipment, and installation according to plans approved by management.

**Supplies and Purchasing**

* Monitor and replenish packaging, office, kitchen, janitorial, and other operational supplies; maintain reorder levels to prevent shortages.
* Compare vendor pricing and lead times, consolidate orders where practical, and place purchases within approved budgets and purchasing authority.
* Track deliveries, resolve order discrepancies, and verify invoices against orders and receipts before submitting to Accounts Payable.

**Technology and Systems Support**

* Answer basic questions about Shopify and other approved systems by referring employees to existing SOPs and guiding them through documented steps.
* Provide basic troubleshooting for computers, tablets, printers, scanners, and POS equipment using approved procedures; coordinate technical issues with the external IT provider.
* When documented steps do not resolve an issue and a software bug is suspected, help open a ticket with Shopify Support or the relevant application provider. Capture screenshots, error messages, steps to reproduce the issue, and operational impact.
* Track support tickets through resolution, communicate updates, and confirm the issue is resolved with the affected employee. Escalate process questions not covered by an SOP to the appropriate internal owner.
* Maintain equipment assignment records and coordinate approved onboarding and offboarding requests, including device setup, returns, and account access changes, with HR and the IT provider.

**Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain a shared request tracker for facilities, supplies, and technology issues, recording priority, owner, status, and next steps.
* Prepare concise updates on open requests, recurring issues, supply and maintenance spending, and upcoming needs for the Senior Retail Operations Manager.
* Pull established operational reports as assigned and flag exceptions for review. Identify gaps in existing SOPs and refer proposed updates to the responsible process owner.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

Systems responsibilities are limited to support using approved procedures, documentation, and escalation. Business rules, data governance standards, data accuracy audits, and technical administration remain with the designated business and technology owners.

**QUALIFICATIONS & KEY ATTRIBUTES**

* 3-5 years experience in workplace operations, retail operations, facilities coordination, office administration, or a similar support role.
* Strong organization and follow through, with the ability to coordinate vendors, track requests, and manage priorities across multiple locations.
* Comfort with basic technology troubleshooting and the ability to explain established procedures clearly and patiently.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Excel or Google Sheets, including maintaining trackers, sorting and filtering information, and using basic formulas.
* Familiarity with Shopify or Shopify POS is preferred, along with experience using support tickets or project management tools.
* Experience obtaining quotes, purchasing supplies, reviewing invoices, and working within approved budgets.
* Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, discretion with company information, and sound judgment about when to escalate issues.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

Work is performed in retail and office environments and includes computer use, walking locations to identify service needs, and coordinating onsite vendors. Local travel between assigned locations may be required. The role involves handling routine supplies and small technology equipment, with assistance as needed. Work location, schedule, and location coverage will be established by managemen

* Assist with event plans and pre-production deliverables for upcoming events.

* Place orders and track deliveries for event materials and supplies.

* Strong problem-solving, time management, and follow-up skills.

jobs.title: Client & Event Coordinator

jobs.title: Operations & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Operations & Events Coordinator**

**Los Angeles, CA | Part-Time**

**About the Role**

This is a varied, hands-on position for someone who enjoys staying busy, solving practical problems, and seeing their work make a difference.

You might spend one day preparing event materials and organizing supplies, another picking up items around Los Angeles, and another helping set up technology or supporting an event on-site.

**You’ll have established tools, checklists, and direction to work from. We need someone who can use those tools consistently, manage their own assignments, and move work forward without needing constant reminders.** You don't need to design new systems or manage entire events independently. You do need to take responsibility for your part, communicate clearly, and follow through.

The workload varies throughout the year, with lighter periods between events and busier periods when an event is approaching. This makes the role a good fit for someone seeking part-time work with flexibility, variety, and opportunities to contribute.

**What You'll Do**  
**Event Preparation & On-Site Support**

* Prepare event materials, including name tags, signage, check-in sheets, printed documents, and activity supplies.
* Manage a high volume of printing, including handouts, postcards, signage, and other event materials, and check that everything is printed correctly and ready on time.
* Gather, organize, transport, and keep track of supplies and equipment needed for events.
* When teammates propose an idea or add content to an event, anticipate the materials, supplies, and setup it will need, and flag what has to be ordered, made, or picked up so everything is ready in time.
* Handle local errands, such as picking up supplies or arranging dry cleaning for event materials.
* Help set up event spaces, tables, signage, registration areas, and equipment.
* Set up and troubleshoot event technology as needed.
* Assist with event breakdown, packing, and returning materials to storage.
* Provide hands-on support during events and step in where needed to keep things running smoothly.
* Occasionally coordinate volunteers at events, making sure they know where to be and what they're responsible for.
* Help lead games or interactive activities when appropriate.

**Administrative & Organizational Support**

* Use the team's existing master checklists, project trackers, templates, and instructions to guide your work.
* Keep assigned tasks moving and update their status in the appropriate tracking tools.
* Keep shared directories and file repositories organized and up to date.
* Prepare, organize, and update event documents, materials, and SOPs so they stay current, and occasionally write new SOPs when a process needs one.
* Handle physical mail and packages, including receiving deliveries, shipping items, and sending postcards and other mailings.
* Keep track of deadlines, outstanding assignments, and details that need attention.
* Follow established processes and ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
* Flag missing information, delays, or problems early so they can be addressed.

**Ownership & Problem-Solving**

* Take responsibility for assigned tasks from start to finish without needing constant supervision.
* Use the information and tools provided to determine next steps and make steady progress.
* Communicate proactively about progress, obstacles, and anything that needs a decision.
* Notice what needs attention and offer help when appropriate.
* Adapt when plans change and remain calm when unexpected issues arise.
* Follow through on commitments and make sure completed work is reflected in the appropriate tracking tools.
* Suggest practical improvements when you notice opportunities to make event preparation or execution smoother.

**Who We're Looking For**

We care more about how you work than whether your career has followed a traditional path.

You might have experience in event production, film, entertainment, administration, operations, project support, hospitality, or another hands-on field. You might be building experience while pursuing other professional interests, or bringing years of experience from a previous career into a flexible role with a meaningful mission.

What matters most is that you're capable, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of your work.

**You'll likely be a good fit if you:**

* **Take ownership.** Once you know how we work, you can take an assignment, understand what it's for, and see it through without needing constant check-ins.
* **Make our systems work for you.** We have checklists, trackers, and simple processes that make the work easier. You're happy to use them, keep your tasks updated as you go, and help the team see where things stand.
* **Follow through.** You remember the details, meet deadlines, and make sure things are actually finished—not just started.
* **Communicate clearly.** You ask good questions, share updates, and flag problems before they become bigger issues.
* **Take initiative.** You notice what needs doing, anticipate practical needs, and step in when appropriate.
* **Think ahead about materials.** When a teammate pitches an idea or wants to add something to an event, you start picturing what it will take: what needs to be bought, printed, borrowed, built, or picked up, and by when.
* **Stay resourceful under pressure.** You can adjust when plans change, solve everyday problems, and keep a level head when an event gets busy.
* **Enjoy hands-on work.** You're comfortable moving supplies, setting up spaces, running errands, and helping with whatever needs attention.
* **Bring positive energy.** You're comfortable interacting with different people and can help create a welcoming, engaging atmosphere at events.
* **Care about the mission.** You appreciate the opportunity to help create experiences that make a difference for young people.

--------------

With a rich history and a bright future ahead, we are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing growth and success.

jobs.description:
**What We Do**

At GoGuardian, we're helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world's greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.

**What It's Like to Work at GoGuardian**

We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

**The Role**

We are looking for an exceptional individual to own GoGuardian's channel partner business within a defined region. This role combines data-driven decision making, partner relationship management, and business development. You will bring significant experience working with resellers and distributors in the educational technology sector, and you'll be a self-starter and energy amplifier with a proven ability to turn strategy into regional growth.

You will own your region's partner portfolio end to end, from joint business plans and pipeline to onboarding new partners and resolving channel conflict. You'll work alongside our Channel Operations Specialist, who runs the operational side of our indirect business, so your time stays focused on partners, pipeline, and results. Your success will be measured by the strength of your partner relationships and the growth of your region's pipeline and bookings.

This role will live within close driving distance of a major Southeast airport as this role will represent us at field events requiring travel up to 30% of the time.

**What You'll Do**

* **Regional Partner Ownership & Development:** Own the portfolio of resellers, distributors, and solution partners in your region, building strong relationships between partner and GoGuardian reps and leadership. Lead new partner onboarding and grow existing partners' capabilities and performance.
* **Data-Driven Performance & Business Reviews:** Analyze data on regional performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead partner business reviews to evaluate results, address gaps, and drive improvement.
* **Pipeline Development & Forecasting:** Build and manage a robust pipeline across your regional partner network, supporting accurate forecasting, execution of joint business plans, and consistent growth in bookings.
* **Sales Alignment & Account Planning:** Drive sales planning, account mapping, and partner alignment with GoGuardian's regional sales teams to identify opportunities and generate pipeline.
* **Channel Program Execution:** Lead regional execution of channel programs, including partner SPIFs, events, and collaborative initiatives that drive partner engagement and business growth.
* **Escalations, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:** Manage regional partner escalations, customer satisfaction, and channel conflicts while partnering with Channel Operations, Sales, and cross-functional GoGuardian teams. Collaborate with fellow Regional CAMs to drive shared success. Stay current on industry trends and adapt regional strategies to meet evolving market demands.

**Who You Are**

* Related experience in channel account management, business development, or partner management, with a strong emphasis on resellers and distributors.
* Proven expertise in data analysis and decision-making leveraging AI. You can interpret large datasets and turn them into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
* Experience with performance metrics, incentive programs, and pipeline management. You're comfortable using dashboards and reports to communicate results and progress.
* A track record of owning a territory or partner portfolio and growing its bookings.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to present complex data and strategies clearly, from partner sellers to senior leadership.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset who drives initiatives independently and rallies cross-functional teams to achieve results.
* Proven track record of building strong relationships and working collaboratively with partners to drive mutual business success.
* High energy and passion for technology and education. You're excited about amplifying partner success and bringing innovative solutions to schools and districts.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay, complete health insurance, 401(k) matching, and an employee equity plan.
* Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a paid year-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, fertility & adoption reimbursement, and more…

*Plus the intangible:*

* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

The typical total on target earnings (OTE) for this position is $115,000 – $135,000. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for this position and your pay will be determined by a variety of factors, including your primary work location, skills, qualifications and experience. Additional benefits information is listed on our careers page.

Please share this with your friends or co-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talente

jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: Blank Spaces- 929 Colorado Ave, Santa Monica, CA.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

Ensure full compliance with international trade regulations, customs requirements, and industry standards.

jobs.title: Account Manager, VaaS (Vault-as-a-Service)
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We’re looking for an ***Account Manager, VaaS*** who will run a large book of smaller and newer Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) partners. You'll get them to live fast on a standard playbook, keep them healthy and spot the ones ready to grow. You're accountable for each account's revenue and retention.

  

*What VaaS is:*

PSA Vault stores graded cards for their owners. Vault-as-a-Service (VaaS) lets other companies build on it. Marketplaces, live-commerce apps, pack and break platforms, games and fantasy apps, fintechs and retailers use our APIs to store cards, transfer ownership between their customers and ship cards to a customer's door. They get vaulting and fulfillment without building a warehouse. The program went live in 2026, and new partners signed most weeks.

  

*Your book:*

You'll manage smaller partners on our standard rate card, plus new partners until they scale, across every part of the hobby. Expect many accounts, a light touch on each and repeatable launches. Your starting book is set when you join and rebalanced each quarter.

  

You’ll report to the *General Manager, VaaS* . ***Remote or hybrid candidates will also be considered.*** ***We believe that there is significant value in in-person collaboration. If you live within a 1 hour commuting distance to one of our offices, you will be required to be onsite most of the time. This will be discussed further as part of the recruiting process.***

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Fast, standard launches.** Take each account from BD at signature, run the handoff and get the partner live on our standard onboarding playbook with as little custom work as possible.
* **Onboarding playbook.** Improve the onboarding playbook, self-serve materials and partner documentation as you go, so launches take less time.
* **Revenue and renewals.** Own revenue, renewals and expansion for your book within our standard pricing. Keep a health score for every partner.
* **Contract terms.** Know each account's pricing, minimums and SLAs, and hold both sides to them.
* **Forecasting.** Flag partner launches and campaigns to Vault Operations early, with a volume estimate.
* **Escalations.** Own the partner side of every issue: triage, updates and the SLA clock. Vault Operations, Product and Support fix the problem; you make sure it gets fixed and keep the partner informed.
* **Moving accounts up.** When a partner outgrows the standard tier, hand it to a Senior AM with an account plan.
* **Coverage.** Cover the Senior AMs' accounts during absences and peak periods.

*What you won't own:*

* Prospecting and closing new partners. BD does that.
* Billing and collections. Finance runs them; you own invoice accuracy and step in when an account falls behind.
* Fixing operational issues. Vault Operations does; you own the partner side.
* Custom deals. Anything outside standard terms goes to a Senior AM or the GM.

*Your first 90 days:*

* **Days 1–30:** learn the vault end to end (intake, imaging, ownership transfer, withdrawal, claims). Shadow the Senior AMs. Take over your book with a handoff on every account.
* **Days 31–60:** launch your first partners on the standard playbook. Put a health score on every account.
* **Days 61–90:** ship one improvement to the playbook or partner docs that cuts launch time. Flag the first accounts ready to move up a tier.

*What a typical week looks like:*

* Kickoffs and launch check-ins with new partners
* Answering partner questions in Slack and email, and routing issues to the right team
* Health-score review across your book
* Account notes in the CRM and a weekly update to the GM

*How we'll measure success:*

* Partners launched per quarter, and time from signature to first revenue
* Net and gross revenue retention for your book
* Accounts moved up a tier
* Overdue receivables

*Who you'll work with:*

Senior Account Managers, Business Development, VaaS Product & Engineering, Vault Operations, PSA Offers and Finance.

  

**Who You Are:**

*Required Qualifications:*

* 3–5 years in account management, customer success, partner operations or SaaS onboarding
* Experience running a high-volume book of B2B accounts (dozens at once)
* A clear writer who's comfortable with technical documentation and basic API concepts
* An eye for early signs that a partner is ready to grow or likely to leave
* You're skilled with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) and use them to get more done: research an account, analyze us

Overview::

**Project Coordinator - HGA Community+Live, Workplace & Government Architecture Team!**

Location: **San Francisco, CA**

HGA is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Community + Live, Workplace & Government Architecture team in our San Francisco, CA. This role plays a key part in driving project success across all phases—from early design through documentation and construction.

The Project Coordinator independently manages tasks of moderate size and complexity while supporting project teams with strong communication, technical capability, and organizational skill. Working under general supervision, this role contributes to design development, coordinates with consultants, engages directly with clients, and assists in preparing critical project deliverables. The position also begins to take on mentorship responsibilities, helping guide junior staff and modeling sound judgment in both design and technical decision-making.

**In this role you will:**

**Design & Documentation**

  

* Independently develop architectural drawings, details, and design layouts.
* Conduct design analyses and planning studies to inform project direction.
* Prepare construction documents using Revit and AutoCAD with minimal oversight.
* Compile and analyze data to support design decisions and project goals.
* Assist in writing specifications and coordinating building systems.

**Project Coordination**

  

* Manage assigned portions of project scope, schedule, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with consultants and internal teams to ensure design alignment.
* Review submittals, RFIs, and drawings for compliance and clarity.
* Support construction administration through site visits and field reports.
* Maintain organized documentation and contribute to project records.

**Communication & Collaboration**

  

* Communicate effectively with Project Managers, Principals, and consultants.
* Participate in design meetings and contribute to collaborative problem-solving.
* Present ideas clearly and document decisions for team reference.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to a culture of learning and accountability.

**Professional Growth**

  

* Continue developing expertise in codes, specifications, and construction processes.
* Seek opportunities to lead design tasks and contribute to project strategy.
* Expand proficiency in BIM workflows and project management tools.
* Demonstrate initiative, technical rigor, and a commitment to design excellence.

**What you will need to have:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture from an accredited institution.
* 5–7 years of professional experience.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with BIM workflows and project management tools (e.g., VantagePoint).

**Salary Information:**

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $84,000 - $92,000 **depending on qualifications and experience**.

**Additional Information:**

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.

Learn more about us **here****.**

**Application Requirements & Instructions**  
Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

jobs.title: JJSE Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Mission Graduates** is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-12 students in San Francisco's Mission District who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of afterschool support services that serve over 4,800 children, youth, and families each year. Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhood so that college becomes the expectation for Mission families, rather than the exception.

**Program Summary:** Mission Graduates has been providing quality afterschool programming for its entire 50-year history. The organization is partnering with June Jordan School of Equity (JJSE) to develop and implement a quality afterschool program that blends extracurricular activities and builds a college-going culture on campus. Youth who participate in the program develop a sense of self-confidence in their ability to learn, to speak their voice, and contribute to their community. The program infuses college messaging throughout its curriculum to ensure both youth and parents develop or strengthen expectations for entering college.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Primary Duties**

### **Program Management & Evaluation (25%)**

Assist in the maintenance of all program records, particularly maintenance of attendance.  
Assist the Director in developing and managing the annual program budget.  
Maintain knowledge of ExCEL policies and procedures.  
Assist in program evaluation and the utilization of evaluation findings in program development to ensure positive outcomes.  
Assist in the preparation of funding proposals and reports to funders.

### **Program Quality, Support, & Delivery (50%)**

* Work with program staff to deliver quality afterschool programming, including supervision of at least three clubs or programs.

  + Lead the JJSE leadership student group, meeting weekly. Create meeting agendas, lead activities, and support students in running school-wide events.
  + Manage the academic tutoring program and referral process.
* Uphold all school-site policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

* Assist in the preparation of internal marketing materials to be disseminated to students, parents, and the JJSE community.
* Collaborate closely with community stakeholders including parents and caregivers, community-based organizations, and SFUSD.
* Assist the JJSE Director in developing parent engagement activities and maintaining positive parent relations with current JJSE families.
* Assist and lead summer programming in academics, enrichment, and/or recreation.

### **Supervise Consultants & Volunteers (10%)**

* In collaboration with other MG team members, oversee recruitment, training, and supervision of volunteers and program consultants.
* Assist/Support the SFUSD teachers and staff who are given stipends to implement Extended Day clubs and activities.

### **Family Recruitment and Outreach (15%)**

* Engaging with families to facilitate two-way communication and information sharing, highlighting school and program activities at JJSE.
* Attend high school tabling events at middle schools and positively represent JJSE to prospective families.
* Reach out to prospective high school families in the neighborhood and middle schools to share JJSE programs and schedule school tours.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of proven experience and ability in working in education and/or youth programs.
* Demonstrated knowledge of and experience with best practices in youth development program planning, curriculum development, teaching methods, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with college access challenges that are specific to first-generation college students.
* Familiarity and experience working with undocumented youth.
* Bilingual Spanish/English fluency preferred.
* BA or BS required.
* Current CPR certification (or attained within 2 months of employment).
* TB test clearance is required before hiring.
* Experience working in communities of color with low-income populations.
* Some weekends and evenings required

**Benefits Package:** Includes fully paid Medical, Dental, and Vision for the employee; access to Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits; and access to a 403(b) account at the time of hire. We also offer an employer contribution for eligible staff\* (eligibility to be explained at the time of hire). In addition, we offer 13 paid holidays per year, 8 personal hours per year, and PTO accrual (vacation and sick).

*Mission Graduates Is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

*Mission Graduates provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, termination, leaves of absence, training, and compensation, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, uniformed service member/veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, medical condition or disability, in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**The Company**

**About Hitachi America, Ltd.**

Hitachi America, Ltd. is the regional headquarters for Hitachi Group companies in the Americas, overseeing the U.S., Canada, and Latin America markets. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Hitachi Americas has been deeply committed to its Social Innovation Business since its establishment in 1959, addressing society's most pressing challenges through innovative solutions. Leveraging its expertise and resources, Hitachi Americas and its subsidiary companies operate across diverse sectors, including transportation, energy, mobility, industrial manufacturing, healthcare, digital engineering, data analytics and others. Driven by Digital, Green, and Innovation, Hitachi Americas remains at the forefront of pioneering solutions that shape the future. For further details, please visit https://www.hitachi.us/ .

Through its Social Innovation Business (SIB) that brings together IT, OT (Operational Technology) and products, Hitachi contributes to a harmonized society where the environment, wellbeing, and economic growth are in balance. Hitachi operates globally in four sectors – Digital Systems & Services, Energy, Mobility, and Connective Industries – and the Strategic SIB Business Unit for new growth businesses. With Lumada at its core, Hitachi generates value from integrating data, technology and domain knowledge to solve customer and social challenges.

**Summary**

Hitachi America's R&D Division in Santa Clara is Hitachi's research arm in North America. Its labs work with Hitachi's businesses in rail, energy, industry and digital infrastructure, and with research counterparts in Japan, to take new technology from the lab into use. One of its largest current efforts is a multi-site Physical AI program with Hitachi businesses and partners in the Americas, bringing robots and AI systems into the inspection and operation of industrial sites.

  

The Program Coordinator sits in the division's Program Management Office and is the coordinator for this program. The job is to keep its many parties moving together: the division's labs, Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions, the Hitachi businesses that host the sites, and outside partners such as technology providers, universities and startups. The role owns the program plan, meeting schedule, action tracking, stakeholder records and reporting. It suits someone who has run a program with many stakeholders and wants to learn how industrial AI is put to work.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain the program plan and calendar across sites, labs and partners. Prepare and run program meetings and workshops, record the decisions, and make sure the actions get done.
* Keep track of what the program has promised to each business, partner and research counterpart, with dates, deliverables and reporting, and tell the program's leadership early when something is slipping.
* Be the first contact for program members and outside parties on schedules, information and logistics. Bring new members from the labs, businesses and partners up to speed, and organize site visits and travel.
* Coordinate with Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions so that work on the program stays aligned across time zones, and keep a shared record of who is doing what.
* Follow the Program Management Office's processes for external engagements, agreements and contracts, working with Legal and the business units as needed.
Write status reports and briefing notes for R&D management, business sponsors and counterparts in Japan, with input from the technical leads, and make sure that what goes to partners meets export control, intellectual property and confidentiality rules.  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, and three or more years coordinating a program with many stakeholders.
* A record of keeping a program on schedule when the people involved sit in several organizations and none of them report to the coordinator.
* Clear writing, and the ability to turn a technical discussion into a short summary that an executive or a partner can act on.
* Careful with detail. Plans, trackers and records stay accurate and current.
* Interest in robotics, AI and industrial technology. A technical background helps but is not required; willingness to learn Hitachi's businesses is essential.
* Comfortable working across organizations, cultures and time zones, including with colleagues in Japan. Experience in an international organization is a plus.
Fluent with AI tools in everyday work, such as drafting and summarizing documents, preparing meeting notes and keeping plans and trackers current, and keen to find where they can take over routine coordination.

We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. **POSITION DESCRIPTION:**

Under the direction of the Site Coordinator, the Program Specialist is responsible for providing 1:1 and/or small group social and emotional support as well as behavioral intervention and coaching to school age children during after school programs and/or summer. Responsibilities also include the coordination of support services and communication with school day and afterschool staff and families.

* Provide one-on-one and/or small group social and emotional support as well as behavioral coaching using positive reinforcement strategies to a caseload of school age children.

We are proud of our reputation in the community: One built on compassion, innovation, collaboration and delivering high-quality care. Come join the team that makes this happen.**

**Applicants MUST apply for position(s) by submitting a separate application for each individual job posting number they are interested in being considered for.**

1

80

Day: 8 hours

**Job Description**

The Professional Development (PD) Program Coordinator administers and coordinates the day-to-day operation of El Camino

Health’s professional development and clinical education programs, such as the HealthStream learning management system

(LMS), Relationship-Based Care (RBC), Crisis Prevention Instruction (CPI), the ECH Clinical Ladder program, and more.

Reporting to the Director of Clinical Education, this role serves as the central point of coordination and governance for these

programs by ensuring learning assignments, competencies, records, and program logistics are accurate, timely, compliant,

and consistently delivered across clinical staff.

Working with a high degree of independence, the PD Program Coordinator handles a wide range of program administration

tasks, resolves atypical or infrequently occurring issues using established precedents and practices, and applies discretion to

improve workflows and prevent avoidable rework. The role safeguards the integrity of regulatory-required training and

competency records, supports organizational readiness for Joint Commission surveys and Magnet Program requirements, and

serves as a resource to those who rely on these programs.

In addition to program coordination, the role provides direct administrative support to the operational leaders of these

programs, including the Director of Clinical Education, the Director of the Magnet Program, and the Director of Clinical

Business Operations by coordinating meetings, materials, reporting, and follow-up that keep initiatives organized and on

track.

**Job Description**

* Administers the HealthStream LMS: builds, assigns, schedules, and maintains courses, curricula, competencies, and

regulatory modules; manages user accounts, groups, and permissions; troubleshoots access and completion issues; and

maintains accurate learning and competency records across clinical.

* Serves as the central coordinator for assigned professional development programs, including Relationship-Based Care,

Crisis Prevention Instruction, Clinical Ladder, and others by managing enrollment, scheduling, materials, tracking, and

logistics so each program is delivered consistently and on schedule.

* Establishes and maintains centralized governance and quality controls over learning assignments to prevent duplicate,

outdated, or missed module assignments and to reduce avoidable retraining and rework.

* Monitors mandatory education and competency due dates; proactively identify at-risk assignments and coordinates with

Nursing Professional Development Specialists (NPDS) and Clinical Managers to maintain survey readiness.

* Generates, maintains, and distributes completion, compliance, and competency reports; responds accurately and

promptly to requests from leadership, regulatory bodies, and accrediting agencies (e.g., Joint Commission, CDPH, CMS,

Magnet).

Professional Development Program Administrator – Version 2

* Applies discretion to modify and improve program workflows, standard operating procedures, and coordination

standards that increase efficiency and enhance the participant and stakeholder experience.

* Resolves atypical or non-routine program, scheduling, LMS, and data issues using established precedents and practices;

escalates broader risks as appropriate.

* Maintains program documentation, job aids, and reference materials; guides and supports NPDS, managers, and staff in

jobs.title: Influencer & Affiliate Marketing Coordinator – Ole Henriksen
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.

Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct-to-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:

* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever- constant, and agility is our strength.
* Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.
  

The salary range for this position is $33.50/hr - $37.25/hr per year. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in-office, with Monday and Friday remote.

  

The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.

  

**SUMMARY**

The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of experience in influencer relations/marketing/PR, with a strong foundation in affiliate marketing, including TikTok Shop, ShopMy, and LTK. Experience with YouTube’s affiliate programming is a plus. They should have superior organizational and problem-solving skills, impeccable attention to detail, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Help support the Ole Henriksen ambassador program, develop creative briefs, and actively manage communication with ambassadors.
* Support the development and execution of influencer marketing strategies and plans across platforms, with a particular focus on TikTok Shop and affiliate programs, such as ShopMy.
* Assist with end-to-end management of TikTok Shop, YouTube affiliate activations, ShopMy, and other affiliate campaigns, including creator onboarding, tracking performance, and optimizing campaigns based on insights.
* Partner with creators to generate engaging, on-brand content; provide creative guidance and inspiration for influencers producing affiliate-related content.
* Assist the Global Influencer Marketing team with administrative tasks, including placing product orders, managing purchase orders and invoices, shipping/tracking samples and gifts, booking travel, preparing for meetings, and organizing/updating key internal documents and databases.
* Responsibly represent the brand and build/manage relationships with influencer partners, talent managers, affiliate platforms, and contacts at each social network.
* Monitor trends, creator performance, and competitor activity to develop insights and optimize influencer and affiliate strategies.
* Help manage the annual influencer/affiliate budget, forecasting, planning, and tracking to optimize spend based on business objectives.
  

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, plus 1–2 years of relevant job experience, preferably in influencer relations, marketing, and/or PR on brand and/or agency side; beauty experience a plus.
* Experience with affiliate programs (TikTok Shop required; ShopMy and YouTube affiliate program experience a plus).
* Strong understanding of short-form video content and trends; content creation/editing skills (TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts) preferred.
* Exceptional organizational skills with keen attention to detail.
* Strong time management skills; ability to juggle multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced, often-changing environment.
* Superior communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Self-motivated; ability to work independently and within teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Entrepreneurial spirit – able to cope with ambiguity and work independently with little or no direction.
* Proactive problem-solving skills; ability to anticipate obstacles and quickly generate alternate solutions/ideas.
* Effective relationship-building skills; professional savvy and organizational agility to leverage partnerships across the organization.
* Can-do, positive attitude and a roll-up-your-sleeves approach; personable and flexible with evolving business needs.
* Passion for the skincare industry.
* Savvy in digital, social media & influencer trends and best practices.

jobs.title: Food Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

For 50 years, the Food Bank, made up of a diverse staff, dedicated Board of Directors and passionate volunteers, has been leading the fight to end hunger in partnership with our community and in service of our neighbors in need.

**About this Opportunity**

The Food Purchasing Coordinator supports the Food Bank of Contra Costa and Solano’s procurement function by executing day-to-day purchasing activities that keep our warehouses stocked with the nutritious food our neighbors depend on. Working closely with the Food Purchasing Manager, this role manages vendor communications, purchase orders, delivery coordination, and inventory tracking to ensure a reliable, well-documented food supply. By keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, the Food Purchasing Coordinator plays a meaningful part in our mission to end hunger.

**Essential Duties**

* Initiate food purchases within established inventory levels and purchasing guidelines to maintain adequate inventory of dry, chilled, and frozen food products.
* Obtain quotes from vendors, manufacturers, and suppliers, capturing brand, label, nutritional information, photos, and shelf-life data, and provide them to the Food Purchasing Manager for review.
* Process Purchase Orders in Ceres (Navision), maintaining and updating all PO documentation.
* Follow up on invoices and liaise with vendor accounts to obtain required supporting documents.
* Record and track purchases against grant budgets in Excel, following purchasing procedures and funder and audit rules.
* Find and onboard local farms and regional producers to grow local food supply.
* Coordinate purchasing and delivery logistics for projects like emergency meal boxes and kit builds, from vendor quotes to delivery.
* Work with Programs, Agency Relations, and program managers to plan purchases around community and program needs.
* Plan holiday food purchases to meet seasonal demand.
* Monitor delivery ETAs and communicate daily with vendors on scheduling updates.
* Maintain the food delivery calendar and database and keep warehouse staff informed of changes.
* Report on delayed shipments and flag inventory shortfalls in a timely manner.
* Follow product integrity and shelf-life procedures.
* Keep department records and archives organized and up to date.
* Attend department and organization-wide meetings, trainings, and team-building events.
* Operate Food Bank vehicles as needed.
* May need to work occasional weekend days for programs and events.

**Skills and Qualifications**

**Required**

* Two or more years of food and beverage purchasing experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with order processing systems.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and creative problem-solving ability.

* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

* Quantitative skills including the ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and interpret basic data.

* Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.

* A California driver’s license and ability to be insured under the Food Bank’s insurance policy.

* Genuine commitment to and enthusiasm for working with people of diverse backgrounds, cultures, and lived experiences; a demonstrated ability to engage respectfully and effectively across difference.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with Ceres, Navision, or similar ERP/inventory systems.

* Experience in a nonprofit, mission-driven, or community-based environment.

**Competencies**

* Adaptability — Remaining effective across changing conditions by welcoming feedback, shifting approaches as needed, and balancing competing priorities.

* Cooperation — Engaging colleagues with respect and tact to build productive relationships, resolve conflicts, and collaborate effectively.

* Dependability — Consistently following through on responsibilities with accountability, reliability, and a commitment to doing one's best work.

* Job Knowledge — Maintaining the technical proficiency and contextual understanding needed to perform one's role effectively and independently.

* Organization Support — Upholding the organization's values, policies, and mission.

* Teamwork — Collaborating with a focus on collective success by balancing individual and group responsibilities and exchanging feedback openly.

**Additional Information**

In instances of a federal, state, or locally declared emergency, Food Bank is typically considered an essential service and emergency responder; all its employees may be called in to perform regular or emergent duties.

**Work Location**

This is an on-site position. Remote work is not guaranteed and may be granted solely at the discretion of the department head.

**Work Environment**

This position works in a mixed office and warehouse environment with frequent exposure to moving mechanical parts and fluctuating temperatures. The noise level is generally moderate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

San Francisco, United States of America | Full time | Field-based | R1579515

  

### **Henlius US Key Account Manager**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a field-based commercial leader responsible for driving the successful adoption, demand generation, and market access of Henlius US oncology biosimilar products across Community Oncology Practices, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), Academic Medical Centers, and Key Cancer Centers.

Reporting to the Regional Business Director, the Key Account Manager will operate in a highly collaborative, startup environment, serving as the primary customer-facing representative responsible for developing strategic account partnerships, identifying growth opportunities, influencing key stakeholders, and executing business plans that maximize patient access and commercial performance.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of oncology treatment pathways, biosimilar market dynamics, buy-and-bill economics, GPO contracting, and complex healthcare decision-making structures. This individual will build trusted relationships with clinicians, practice administrators, pharmacy leadership, and health system decision-makers while working cross-functionally to achieve business objectives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Strategic Account Management**

* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account business plans aligned with organizational objectives and market opportunities.
* Establish, cultivate, and expand strategic relationships within community oncology practices, IDNs, academic institutions, and major cancer centers.
* Identify and influence key stakeholders involved in clinical, operational, financial, and pharmacy decision-making processes.
* Create account-specific growth strategies that accelerate biosimilar adoption, utilization, and pull-through within targeted accounts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key oncology providers, administrators, infusion leaders, pharmacists, and executive decision-makers.

### **Market Access & Contract Optimization**

* Drive awareness, utilization, and pull-through of contracted business across GPOs, IDNs, and health system networks.
* Partner with customers to optimize product access and address barriers related to formulary placement, procurement, reimbursement, inventory management, and operational workflows.
* Collaborate with Market Access and Contracting teams to ensure customers understand the economic and clinical value proposition of Fosun Henlius products.
* Support account adoption strategies by identifying opportunities to improve access and operational efficiencies.

### **Customer Engagement & Clinical Business Leadership**

* Serve as the trusted business partner for customers by delivering customer-centric solutions that enhance patient access and support quality oncology care.
* Conduct high-impact customer interactions, including individual engagements, account reviews and business presentations.
* Demonstrate strong account-based selling capabilities through tailored engagement strategies across multiple customer segments.
* Leverage data analytics, market intelligence, customer insights, and territory performance metrics to prioritize opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
* Maintain a deep understanding of oncology treatment landscapes, biosimilar trends, competitive products, reimbursement dynamics, and evolving healthcare policies.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Successfully navigate and lead within a complex, matrixed commercial environment.
* Partner closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and other field-based colleagues to deliver coordinated customer solutions.
* Collaboratively develop and execute account plans that improve patient access, drive utilization, and support organizational growth objectives.
* Effectively communicate customer insights and market intelligence to internal stakeholders to influence business strategy and execution.

### **Business Performance & Execution**

* Achieve and exceed sales, revenue, utilization, and market share objectives.
* Maintain disciplined territory management practices, including opportunity planning, account prioritization, call execution, and CRM documentation.
* Manage territory resources and budget responsibly to maximize return on investment and customer impact.
* Execute brand strategies, promotional initiatives, and tactical programs consistent with corporate objectives.
* Complete required administrative activities, reporting, training, and compliance requirements in a timely and accurate manner.

### **Compliance & Ethical Conduct**

* Conduct all business activities in accordance with company policies, industry regulations, legal requirements, and ethical standards.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable FDA regulations, PhRMA guidelines, healthcare compliance standards, and company operating procedures.
* Participate in required training and professional development programs to maintain product, disease state, and industry knowledge.

### **Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree required.
* Minimum 7+ years of successful pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare sales experience.
* Minimum 2+ years of current oncology sales experience.

**Account Manager**

  

We help make your world a safer place.

  

Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.

  

Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Account Manager position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by managing the security services and related operations provided to an assigned group of smaller accounts including client service and problem resolution, service enhancement and expansion, new business development, operational effectiveness, preparation of post orders, staffing, scheduling, supervision and training.

  

We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.

  

As an Account Manager you will be performing a variety of management functions for assigned accounts; while providing lead direction to Security Supervisors on requirements, priorities of work and coordinating any necessary needs of the site. If you have experience in positions like Operations Manager, Site Supervisor or Account Manager this role is a great fit for you.

  

Are you interested in being part of our Team?

  

* Apply quickly and efficiently online

* Interview from the convenience of your own home

* Weekly pay

* Competitive benefits

* Flexible schedules

  

With over 80 years of protecting the things that matter, we’ve seen more than most. That’s why Securitas is the partner of choice for companies and an employer of choice for candidates worldwide.

  

See a different world.

  
  
  
  

**Make an Impact at Securitas USA**

Securitas USA employees come from all walks of life, bringing a variety of skills, experiences, and perspectives. United by a shared purpose, we help make the world a safer place. We provide security services to meet the unique needs of our clients to help safeguard their people and assets.

At Securitas USA, our core values are the foundation of everything we do. Represented by the three red dots in our logo, **Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness** guide how we serve our clients, support our colleagues, and engage with our communities.

**Integrity**  
We act with honesty, accountability, and professionalism in everything we do, and we foster a culture where transparency, respect, and ethical behavior are expected.

**Vigilance**  
We stay alert, aware, and attentive to our surroundings. Through observing and reporting, our employees help identify potential risks and respond to situations that may impact safety and security.

**Helpfulness**

Securitas USA is committed to equal employment opportunity.
