jobs.description:
**Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Territory Account Manager**
===================================================================================

At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our rental facility in **Newark, CA**, and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($24,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
* New business development and Client acquisition/Account development. Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business with our comprehensive jobsite solutions.
* Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications. Conducts sales presentations to prospective and existing customers.
* Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience.
* Manages and supports job site activities and projects with remote and on site involvement.
* Assists with Equipment rental, sales, and service when needed by customers on-site.

Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

We're a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.

* Competitive compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Commission guarantee period while building book of business

* Company provided truck or Vehicle allowance ($800/mo)
* Company provided cell phone or phone stipend
* Relocation assistance (discretionary)
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees
* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO + paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events and quarterly team activities
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement  
* Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

* First and foremost, we're looking for someone who's tenacious and innovative and possesses superior outside sales experience and skills with a proven sales track record

* Experience in equipment rental company preferred

### **Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at times.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The **Account Manager** is the primary post-sales partner for clients and agencies, responsible for turning closed deals into high-performing, long-term partnerships. This role owns campaign execution, technical onboarding, continuous optimization, custom reporting, billing and identifying organic upsell and renewal opportunities.

**You Will:**

**Post-Sale Onboarding & Launch:**

* Lead client kick-off calls and gather creative assets.
* Set up campaigns in Roblox's ad management systems and ensure seamless launch workflows.

**Campaign Management & Optimization:**

* Monitor daily campaign pacing and target performance metrics (e.g., VCR, engagement, ROI, CTR).
* Execute real-time optimizations so campaigns meet or exceed client KPIs.

**Client Relationship Management:**

* Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for agency media planners, buyers, and brand managers.
* Deliver high-touch customer support throughout the campaign lifecycle, including proactive campaign updates.

**Data & Performance Insights:**

* Synthesize performance data into insights and mid-campaign performance checks.
* Build post-campaign wrap-up presentations (QBRs/PCRs).

**Upsells & Renewals:**

* Identify campaign performance wins to pitch mid-flight upsells and incremental budget allocations.
* Prepare renewal proposals with the Sales Lead and present them to the client.

**Cross-Functional Operations:**

* Partner with Ad Ops, Sales, Billing, Product, Policy, Measurement, and Trust & Safety to resolve technical issues and manage policy compliance.
* Capture relevant client feedback and ensure clean invoicing.

**You Have:**

* 6-8 years of experience in account management, client success, ad operations, or campaign management in digital advertising or media.
* Experience managing live campaigns, including pacing, optimization, and performance against KPIs such as VCR, engagement, CTR, and ROI.
* Familiarity with digital ad platforms and campaign setup, tracking, and reporting tools.
* Ability to turn performance data into clear insights and client-ready presentations such as QBRs or post-campaign reports.
* Strong relationship management skills with agency media planners, buyers, and brand managers.
* Experience identifying upsell and renewal opportunities and partnering with Sales to close them.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns at once.
* Strong communication skills; able to work with Ad Ops, Billing, Product, Policy, and Measurement partners.

**You May Also Have:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Data Analytics).
* Experience in the media or advertising industry.

**Territory Account Manager, Western US – Life Sciences | No Sales Experience Required (Fremont, CA)**

Use your expertise to make a difference in disease research and drug discovery. AnaSpec’s custom and catalog products support scientists at biopharmaceutical companies, biotechnology organizations, and academic institutions worldwide.

For more information on our company, go to **www.anaspec.com**

**Mission**

The Territory Account Manager will grow AnaSpec’s U.S. business by strengthening existing customer relationships, developing new accounts, and achieving sales targets for our peptide and proteomics products and services.

This position will share U.S. territory coverage with another Territory Account Manager, with account assignments and sales responsibilities coordinated by the Deputy President. The successful candidate will bring hands-on scientific research experience, strong technical background and excellent oral and written communication skills to help customers identify solutions for their research needs.

Prior sales experience is not required. AnaSpec will provide sales training to support the transition from a research or life sciences role into technical account management.

This position reports to the Deputy President and works closely with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and Production at our Fremont headquarters.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales plans to retain existing customers, generate new business, and achieve assigned revenue targets.
* Develop and execute account growth plans through proactive customer contact, upselling, cross-selling, and reactivation of former customers.
* Develop a thorough understanding of AnaSpec’s products and services, including peptides, dyes, and proteomics reagents, to recommend solutions that meet customer needs.
* Build customer relationships through telephone calls, virtual meetings, in-person visits, and technical presentations.
* Prepare and coordinate quotations, follow up on proposals, and work with internal teams to convert opportunities into orders.
* Collaborate with Business Development on opportunities requiring specialized support or strategic account development.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales activities, opportunities, and forecasts in the company’s CRM system.
* Monitor customer purchasing trends, competitor activity, and market developments to identify growth opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to address customer questions, project requirements, and service concerns.
* Participate in relevant trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings as needed.
* Follow applicable company policies, standard operating procedures, and Quality Management System requirements.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
* At least 2-3 years of hands-on research or laboratory experience in life sciences, or in a university and/or academic research environment preferred. Relevant experience as a researcher, research associate, laboratory scientist, or in a comparable life sciences role is welcome.
* Strong technical knowledge of life sciences research, laboratory workflows, and experimental methods, with the ability to understand customer applications and scientific requirements.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain scientific concepts clearly, deliver technical presentations, and prepare accurate, professional correspondence.
* Ability to listen carefully, ask technical questions, and build relationships with researchers and other scientific customers.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office
* Must be based locally in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to commute regularly to AnaSpec’s Fremont headquarters.
* Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with peptides, proteomics, or related research products and applications.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, SAP, or SAP C4C; experience working with international teams is a plus.

**Location and Travel**

* Candidates living within approximately a 30–45-minute drive of Fremont, California, are preferred.
* Regular attendance at AnaSpec’s Fremont headquarters is required for training, team meetings, customer-related activities, and other business needs.
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time for customer visits, conferences, and other business activities.

Annual base salary of $75K-$80K plus a commission package and benefits.

The Account Manager owns client satisfaction, contract delivery, and team performance for assigned accounts. The Executive Assistant operates with a high level of autonomy and judgment, providing advanced administrative and practice support to attorneys, clients, and internal legal teams. In addition to handling core responsibilities essential to client service, workflow coordination, and operations, the Executive Assistant also manages complex client and matter coordination, assists with business development efforts, tracks time-sensitive projects, and facilitates enhanced communication with high-profile clients and stakeholders. * Monitor and triage high-volume attorney inboxes, identifying and addressing priority action items

-----------------------

jobs.description:
Bloom Energy is looking for a driven, curious, and results-oriented **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help identify and develop new business opportunities across our target markets.

As an SDR, you will be on the front line of Bloom’s go-to-market organization, researching strategic accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and engaging prospects around some of the most important energy challenges businesses face today. You’ll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to create qualified pipeline and introduce customers to Bloom Energy’s solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who is competitive, comfortable speaking with senior business and operational leaders, and eager to build a career in enterprise sales.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Research and prioritize target accounts based on factors such as company size, facility footprint, geography, industry, energy requirements, and overall fit.
* Identify and engage key stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Sustainability, Procurement, and executive leadership.
* Execute thoughtful, multi-channel outbound campaigns using phone, email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting methods.
* Develop personalized outreach based on account-specific business drivers rather than relying solely on high-volume, generic messaging.
* Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities to understand account fit, business needs, timing, stakeholders, and potential energy requirements.
* Schedule qualified meetings and facilitate a clean handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
* Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, prioritize prospects, and expand engagement within strategic accounts.
* Maintain accurate and detailed prospecting, qualification, and activity information in Salesforce and other sales systems.
* Follow up quickly and thoughtfully on inbound inquiries, marketing-generated leads, events, campaigns, and prospect responses.
* Continuously develop your knowledge of Bloom Energy, the energy industry, customer use cases, and the business challenges facing commercial and industrial customers.
* Contribute to a high-performance SDR culture focused on accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
    
    
  What We’re Looking For
  + Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Comfortable making outbound calls and engaging prospective customers by phone.
  + Ability to research complex organizations and translate research into relevant, personalized outreach.
  + Strong organization and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple accounts and prospects simultaneously.
  + Competitive and goal-oriented mindset with the ability to operate in a metrics-driven sales environment.
  + Intellectual curiosity and an interest in energy, technology, infrastructure, or enterprise sales.
  + Ability to take coaching, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.
  + Comfortable working collaboratively with Account Executives, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders.
  + Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar sales technology is a plus.

---------------

Amazon Key's SMB organization is looking for a sharp, resourceful, and AI-savvy Executive Assistant to serve as the operational backbone to a VP and additional leaders. This is not a traditional EA role — you will function as a force multiplier for the leadership team, blending executive support with strategic operational leadership to keep priorities aligned, decisions moving, and the organization running at peak efficiency.  
  
The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of people, process, and technology. You are someone who doesn't just manage calendars — you architect them. You don't just handle information — you synthesize it. And when a new AI tool or automation can eliminate friction, you're the first to find it, test it, and put it to work. You bring strong organizational instincts, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to anticipate what leadership needs before they ask. You operate with the highest level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism when engaging with senior executives both inside and outside of Amazon.  
  
A successful candidate will be an expert at completing complex tasks quickly with limited guidance, reacting with appropriate urgency to fast-moving situations, and driving effective action across the organization.

Throughout it all, you will use your judgment to anticipate what your leaders need before they ask, keeping operations running smoothly and making a real impact on organizational goals.

**Assistant Production Coordinator | StreetTalk | NYC (In Office, Mon-Fri 9-5)**

Last month we ran 200+ shoots. Every one of them needed the right people, the right place, and the right props, on time. That's the job.

StreetTalk makes street interview video ads for brands. Our hosts hit the streets of NYC, Miami, and LA every day. You'll work directly with our Production Coordinator as her right hand, and you'll be the reason nothing falls through the cracks.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

People

- Coordinate talent and participant scheduling, confirmations, and backups

- Make sure every host knows where to be and what to bring

Places

- Find, call, and lock shoot locations and get approvals

Props

- Run our prop closet, product room, and overflow storage

- Turn creative briefs into shopping lists, order, receive, and shelve

- Prep a ready-to-go bag for every host, every shoot

- Know where every item is and who has it, at all times

On set

- Support stand-in shoots and studio podcast days

- Keep the day on schedule and catch what others miss

A REAL DAY

9:00 unpack 6 deliveries and shelve them

10:00 prep 4 host bags for tomorrow's shoots

11:00 book 8 stand-ins for Friday, line up 3 backups

1:00 two cancel, you've already got the backups confirmed

YOU'RE THE ONE IF

- You thrive on lists, spreadsheets, and systems

DETAILS

jobs.description:
**About the Agency:**

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.

As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.

**Your Team**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be a member of the Public Information team within the agency’s Office of Compliance & Risk Management (CRM). This office includes various compliance, oversight, and hearing functions to ensure fairness, consistency, and equity in both our external and internal engagement. CRM collaborates with programs across HPD to ensure the agency and its partners comply with laws (federal, state, and city), regulatory requirements, policies, and procedures. The Office includes the following Divisions and units:

· Compliance & Strategy

· Economic Opportunity & Regulatory Compliance

· Audit Support

· Adjudications

· Public Information

HPD’s Public Information team is dedicated to serving the public by collaborating with internal partners and governing entities to facilitate access to agency information. The team promotes accountability, transparency, and compliance by:

· Establishing robust infrastructure within the agency to improve record retention and quality;

· Ensuring fair and secure access to agency records and materials for members of the public; and

· Safeguarding sensitive information by setting and maintaining best practices around data privacy and effective record management.

**Your Impact**

As a member of the Public Information team in CRM, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support transparency and public access to information relating to HPD’s mission to provide secure and safe housing in New York City.

**Your Role**

Reporting under general supervision of the Deputy Records Access Officer and FOIL and the eDiscovery Specialist on a dedicated project basis, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will support the agency’s Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) program, working with the FOIL team on a segment of its redaction portfolio. Working in coordination with offices throughout the agency, the FOIL Administrative Coordinator will gain an understanding of the different types of work done by the agency, develop relationships with people throughout HPD, and apply their customer service skills.

The records involved in this project will include, but not be limited to, Complaint Records, Violation Records, and Regulatory Agreements. All activity will be conducted under FOIL supervision.

**Your Responsibilities**

The FOIL Administrative Coordinator will be trained and instructed on requirements and software involved in the following duties:

· Search and retrieve responsive documents from specific agency and/or City websites

· Redact responsive records documents using Adobe Pro software

· Submit redacted documents to the FOIL team for review

· Enter completed FOILs information in an excel spreadsheet

· Assist with obtaining documents from program areas

· Review documents provided by agency personnel to ensure that the FOIL responses are accurate and complete

· Assist with quality assurance checks of FOILs

· Support FOIL requests and inquiries from the public as needed

· Other tasks and requirements identified as the staff becomes more familiar with the agency documents and information

**Please submit a cover letter as part of your application.**

**Preferred Skills**

The ideal candidate will be an inquisitive self-starter and problem-solver with administrative experience.

· Exercises discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information

· Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities

· Effective verbal and written communication skills

· Ability to multi-task with high volume workload

· Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written)

· The ability to keep track of time-sensitive projects, and coordinate with various parties to help complete them

· Comfortable with reading and interpreting documents

**How to Apply:**

Please send resume and cover letter to the HPD FOIL team via AskCompliance@hpd.nyc.gov and include the position in the subject line.

**Salary range:** $32.50/hour for 35 hours/week

**NOTE:** Only those candidates under consideration will be contacted.

**Clinical Research Coordinator I** will oversee multiple clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, and quality improvement projects within the Department of Neurology and support the Department's programs, serving as a point person for patients, their family members and the clinical study team. The position consists of working with various departments across the hospital, including forging new partnerships with departments to ensure completion of trial-related activities. The Clinical Research Coordinator I will direct participants and study team members to adhere to the study protocol and rules and regulations as governed by regulatory bodies including Institutional Review Boards and the FDA.

  

Under general supervision duties will include:

• Directing seamless flow of daily trial-related activities, recruitment and clinical assessments of the study subjects

• Directing strict adherence to the study protocols, as well as sponsor, FDA and other regulatory authority requirements.

• Designs and implements workflows for clinical trials, including reminders/updates to the clinical team

• Coordinating team members to complete both clinical and non-clinical assessments per protocol. This includes developing workflow for patient care such as assigning secretaries to schedule patients, developing workflow with ancillary departments (such as radiology, advanced imaging, pathology, pharmacy), and assigning appropriate clinical team members such as doctors to complete clinical tasks such as reviewing adverse events versus assigning non-clinical team members to complete non-clinical tasks such as administering questionnaires to a patient.

• Executing IRB submissions (event reporting, study status change etc.)

• Executing patient billing in multiple databases including the patient's electronic medical record.

• Developing action plans for ensuring all study tasks are completed as required per the protocol and developing subsequent corrective action plans if any errors are made.

• Coordinating appointments, procedures, and related services, and supporting financial activities.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I will be trained to be highly specialized in clinical trials assigned to them. The Clinical Research Coordinator I is expected to be able to manage clinical trial projects independently after sufficient training is completed.

  

**Essential Functions**

• Escalates issues related to clinical trial conduct to PI and senior research staff.

• Assigns training to the PI and other research team members for protocol amendments, and any other study required training.

• Screens and consents patients and ensures the scheduling and completion of assessments for ongoing study visits as dictated by the protocol.

• Schedules and coordinates appointments, procedures, and related services; records documentation, communications, and related information in the electronic medical record and other systems.

• Serves as a point of contact for patients, providers, sponsors, vendors, and other internal and external parties.

• Collects required data and imaging and ensures data entry into EDCs/Databases and image upload to imaging portals.

• Develops and executes multifaceted recruitment strategies by blending creative patient outreach with technical workflow integration and cross-departmental partnerships to optimize subject identification and enrollment.

• Oversees the quality of data provided to sponsor, escalates quality issues to the site manager.

• Maintains accurate records of study participants while safeguarding the confidentiality of subjects, as necessary.

• Maintains essential documents per FDA, Regulatory bodies, and sponsor requirements in the Regulatory Binder. This includes preparation of essential documents for the assigned clinical study.

• Provides ready access to patient binders and regulatory binders to the PI, Sponsor and/or Regulatory Authorities for assigned clinical trials.

• Coordinates and carries out monitoring visits and audits for assigned clinical trials.

• Collaborates with appropriate institutional review board to ensure approval of the clinical trial (renewal), approval of study documents (renewal, modification, notification) and personnel.

• Assists management with collection of updated essential documents and certifications for site personnel and sends these to sponsor as requested.

• Participates in Site Initiation Visit.

• Processes, packages, stores and ships clinical specimens as required by the protocol.

• Responsible for device accountability, ordering and storage of investigational products and/or lab kits.

• Prepares correspondence, reports, meeting materials, and minutes; maintains, organizes, and archives records in accordance with institutional, sponsor, and regulatory requirements; and maintains inventory of supplies and equipment and coordinates with vendors.

• Provides administrative and operational support to the Department as needed and performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

• BS Required

• OHS Annual Assessment Required

• OHS Fit Test Required

• CITI Good Clinical Practice Certification, CITI Research with Biomedical Drugs and Devices Certification, CITI Dan gerous Goods and Biospecimen Handling Certification.

• Experience in clinical research, clinical trials and/or any medical related profession Preferred

This position will be based at a Department of Neurology campus, with occasional travel to other Montefiore locations as needed.

Job Description

ViiV Healthcare is a global specialty HIV company, the only one that is 100% focused on researching and delivering new medicines for people living with, and at risk of, HIV. ViiV Healthcare is highly mission-driven in our unrelenting commitment to being a trusted partner for all people living with and affected by HIV. Our aim is to think, act, and connect differently through a focus on education on for the prevention and treatment for HIV. We go to extraordinary lengths to deliver the sorts of breakthroughs, both in prevention, treatments, care solutions and communities, that really count. We go beyond the boundaries of medicine by taking a holistic approach to HIV through developing and supporting sustainable community programs and improving access to care. We are fully committed to push through every challenge until HIV/AIDS is eradicated. ViiV Healthcare has played a significant part in delivering breakthroughs that have turned HIV into a manageable health condition. We offer the largest portfolio of HIV medicines available anywhere, and we continue our work to cater for the widest possible range of needs in response to the HIV epidemic.

We are aware of how much is at stake for those at-risk or affected by HIV and we show up every day 100% committed to the patients. Our work culture is fast-paced, diverse, inclusive, competitive, and caring. But ViiV Healthcare isn’t just somewhere to work – it’s a place to belong, an invitation to bring your very best, and a team full of impact-driven team members who are hungry to make a difference.

While we have been improving lives of HIV patients for 30 years, this is an especially exciting time to be at ViiV Healthcare, as we evaluate novel approaches to treatment and prevention that could further reduce the impact of HIV on individuals and communities.

ViiV Healthcare is seeking an experienced, results-driven professional in Specialty Sales for the position of **Territory Account Manager (TAM)** on the HIV Oral Treatment Sales team. Additionally, the abilities to partner cross-functionally and to remain highly adaptable in a launch context will be critical. It is expected that the successful candidate will have demonstrated experience in developing strategic business plans with specific, measurable, action-oriented objectives in accordance with territory and account level goals. Successful outcomes will include selling to HCPs, servicing their accounts, and being aligned to ViiV Healthcare’s mission of leaving no person with HIV behind. This will be achieved through driving results against business objectives and working effectively within an integrated account management framework in the setup and delivery of a buy and bill treatment model.

**About Teleskope**

Teleskope is the only data security platform that automatically resolves data exposure. Powered by its Data Reasoning Layer that understands business context, Teleskope continuously discovers and classifies risky data, determines the appropriate action, and enforces it natively across on-prem, cloud, SaaS, and AI environments, without manual triage or external tools. Unlike DSPM tools that surface findings and stop there, Teleskope closes the loop between detection and resolution. Customers include Ramp, Petco, Dayforce and Notion.

In this agentic era, data risk has quickly become the most widespread, exploitable and urgent challenge faced by enterprises. Teleskope’s unique ability to resolve data risk as it arises positions us as a critical partner to the world’s largest enterprises, helping them to protect their most valuable assets while safely adopting AI.

The market is catching on, and Teleskope is growing like crazy. This is an opportunity to own a critical territory, selling a one-of-a-kind product that sits at the intersection of Data Security and AI Security.

**About the role**

We are seeking an **Enterprise Technical Account Manager** who will be the strategic partner and primary post-sales owner for our largest customers. In this role, you will help customers operationalize Teleskope, drive adoption across teams and stakeholders, and support their most urgent and critical data security initiatives.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering teams to guide customers from conversion through onboarding, implementation, steady-state success, and renewal/upsell. This role is ideal for someone who is highly customer-facing, consultative, and comfortable navigating technical conversations alongside our FDE’s.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the customer relationship after deal close, serving as the primary driver of customer outcomes, adoption, and long-term account health
* Develop and track success plans with defined milestones, business goals, use cases, stakeholders, and measurable success criteria, ensuring customers have a seamless experience operationalizing Teleskope
* Run recurring calls with customers to track progress, remove blockers, align on priorities, and maintain momentum toward shared goals
* Track account health using customer feedback, milestone attainment, product gaps, platform usage, and ensure we are well positioned to retain customers
* Plan, coordinate and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR’s), ensuring customer stakeholders understand the value delivered by Teleskope
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, prioritize key gaps, and advocate for high-value improvements
* Support growth within existing accounts by identifying expansion opportunities, new use cases, and deeper platform adoption paths
* Partner with GTM leadership on renewal planning and customer communications, including stakeholder mapping, renewal readiness, and executive alignment
* Maintain clear customer-facing and internal documentation, including account plans, meeting notes, milestone trackers, success criteria, and escalation summaries
* Help shape and scale Teleskope’s customer success motion, processes, playbooks, and reporting as the company grows

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years in Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a related customer-facing role working closely with technical stakeholders
* Experience owning customer relationships with large enterprises
* Strong fundamentals of account management – building rapport, managing relationships, driving account health, and owning customer success
* Comfort working with technical stakeholders and discussing deployments, integrations, cloud environments, and troubleshooting workflows at a high level
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business value for security, data, engineering, and executive audiences
* Extreme organization, with strong program management instincts and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills, including experience running recurring syncs, workshops, and executive reviews.
* Familiarity with modern SaaS tooling such as CRM systems, project trackers, documentation tools, and customer success workflows.
* **Experience in data security, cloud security, privacy, governance, or adjacent technical domains is a requirement.**
* Must be based in NYC (we work hybrid, in-office Tue/Wed/Thu).

**What You'll Get**

* An opportunity to help shape the core customer experience at an early-stage startup in one of today’s fastest-growing markets.
* Huge opportunity to impact Teleskope's growth and success in the market, working directly with large enterprise customers and Teleskope executives.
* Room to learn, grow, and rapidly advance in your career as part of a growing team.
* A beautiful office in NYC’s Financial District, with breakfast and snacks provided daily, and weekly catered lunch.
* Flexible vacation and work-from-home days.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Health, vision, dental, 401k and more benefits, heavily subsidized by Teleskope.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

jobs.title: Research & Insights Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
### **About Goodie AI:**

Goodie helps leading brands win AI search. As billions of people use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI systems to discover products and make buying decisions, brands need a way to understand and influence how they’re represented.

Goodie gives teams a full AI control plane: real-time visibility into how AI models speak about their brand and products, how competitors show up, and an optimization engine to improve visibility and performance. This category didn’t exist two years ago – we were early, and we’re defining it.

We’re backed by strong investors, trusted by category-leading customers, and scaling fast. We’re hiring curious, ambitious builders to help shape the future of AI search.

**What we’re looking for:**  
You’ll own research from the first question to the published story: run the study, share it, and pitch it to the publications that matter. You are someone who loves digging into data and isn’t waiting to be told what’s next.

You’ll have the support of a team around you, plus the freedom to run your own studies and help our research reach a wider audience. You’ll report to the Director of Growth Marketing, shaping the research roadmap.

**What you’ll do:**

*Run the research*

* Write a one-page study brief before any work starts: the question, hypothesis, data needed, method, and target publish date.
* Define the data set each study needs.
* Request data from our research team, then clean, analyze, and check it.
* Write up what the data shows and what it does not, with a source and date on every number.
* Document each study’s method so the next one is faster.

*Write and publish the findings*

* Turn each study into content for marketing materials, blog, social, email, and other.
* Work with our organic team on drafting and publishing.
* Keep a regular publishing schedule for research across our channels.
* Write research-led pages for the Goodie website, using findings from our studies as proof points so the copy is backed by our own data.

*Pitch the story*

* Write two or three pitch angles per study, each tied to a publication’s recent coverage.
* Build a target list of journalists and editors for every study, and prepare the data and charts they will ask for.
* Send pitches with support from our PR team, and follow up.
* Track every placement, link, and mention in one log.

*Measure and report*

* Set success metrics, a threshold, and a stop date for every study before it publishes.
* Report on each study’s performance from web analytics.
* Recommend what to repeat, change, or stop.

*Beyond the research*

* Contribute to our regular blog publishing, including thought leadership pieces, while studies are in progress, so our publishing rhythm never stalls.
* Prepare content for online and offline events.
* Research competitors and topics to spot gaps that could become your next study.

**What you have:**

* 2+ years experience in marketing, consulting, research, journalism, or analytics.
* Strong writing. You can explain a finding plainly and say clearly what the data cannot support.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets and the habit of checking numbers before they go out.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research, analysis, and drafting, and the judgment to check what they produce before it goes out.
* Curiosity about AI search and how answer engines choose their sources.

**Bonus / nice-to-haves:**

* Experience pitching or working with media, or a clear willingness to learn it.
* Original research that earned media coverage.
* Direct AEO/GEO experience.
* Startup background.

**Benefits & Perks Of Becoming a Goodie:**

* Earn More, Together: Base Pay + Equity
* Health First: Premium Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage
* Flex Work Environment: Hybrid at HQ and Remote Globally
* Set Up Shop: Home Office Stipend
* Recharge Anytime: Unlimited PTO Plan
* Family First: Paid Parental Leave Plan
* Secure Your Future: 401(k) Plan with Employer Matching
* Level Up: Mentorship & Career Growth Support
* Always Be Learning: Access to Top-tier Resources & Industry Experts
* Work Hard, Play Harder: Quarterly Team Trips (Onsite and Offsite)
* Mind & Body Wellness: Gym, Wellness, and Access to Mental Health Plans
* Fuel Your Day: Free Lunch, Snacks, Cold Brew, & Happy Hours
* Grow With Us: Endless Opportunities to Lead & Succeed
* Keep on Shining: Ongoing Employee Development Programs

They act as a central operational point of contact for complex client programs, coordinating with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders. Behind the scenes, they turn what they hear from clients into clear plans, early risk signals, and improved operational processes.

Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who loves digging under the hood? Are you adept at AI, sharp enough to spot a logic flaw or hallucination, and energized by empowering others? If so, we’d love to talk with you!

**What you will be doing:**
---------------------------

* **DIQ Support & AI Escalation Management:** Manage and resolve complex escalations from users or quinn by skillfully utilizing our platform, ticketing systems, and AI tools. Act as the critical bridge between users and Product.
* **Technical & Research Flow Troubleshooting:** Investigate unexpected platform behaviors to isolate software bugs, user error, or flawed survey logic — coordinating seamlessly with Product to drive swift, decisive resolutions.
* **AI Output & Questionnaire Quality Assurance:** Systematically review quinn-generated outputs for technical precision, identifying hallucinations, data inconsistencies, or logic gaps in automated questionnaire designs.
* **Client Empowerment & Enablement:** Take a service- and education-minded approach to every interaction. Educate and train customers on platform capabilities, empowering them to build and run research independently.
* **Platform Mastery, Process Improvement & Product Feedback:** Rapidly master our evolving platform and act as a crucial feedback loop. Analyze support queue trends to recommend workflow optimizations, systematically capturing client friction points to advocate for targeted platform enhancements.

**Who you are:**
----------------

The ideal candidate is a tech-savvy problem solver who understands market research survey mechanics and thrives on empowering customers in an AI-driven SaaS environment.

* T**ech-Savvy Problem Solver:** You have a deep technical aptitude, strong analytical skills, a drive to find solutions, and a passion for untangling complex software issues.
* **Market Research & Survey Flow Aptitude:** You possess a solid understanding of market research fundamentals and survey flow mechanics—including question routing, skip patterns, piping, quota definitions, and screening criteria—allowing you to quickly diagnose flaws in implementation.
* **AI Adept with a Critical Eye:** You leverage AI tools effectively while maintaining a sharp eye for detail to spot hallucinations, mis-statements, or logic gaps in AI-generated outputs.
* **Education-Minded Communicator:** You translate complex technical nuances, bug investigations, and survey workflows into clear, actionable guidance for clients and internal engineering teams.
* **Agile & Process-Oriented:** You thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment, constantly seeking ways to improve support workflows, knowledge base resources, and customer success metrics.
* **Education & Background:** Degree in Information Systems, Business, a related analytical field, or equivalent practical experience in technical support, SaaS enablement, or market research operations.

**Benefits of working at quantilope:**
--------------------------------------

Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?  

Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.  
Wellness is key: We offer full benefits (health, dental, and vision) as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.  
* Diverse & inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.
Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with a 401k program and a 3.5% annual match.  
* Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties.. .where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

  
Compensation: $75k - $86k base + 10% bonus

  

**Über uns**
------------

Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI-driven solutions to support data-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300+ brands.  
  
As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.  
  
Join us and let's see what we can build together!

jobs.title: U.S. Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Contract type:** Permanent, Full-time
* **Reports to:** Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution – London *(dotted line to Head of U.S. Marketing & Fan Activation)*
* **Location:** Premier League Offices, New York City, USA

**Overview**

The Premier League has established an in-market presence to accelerate fan and commercial growth across the U.S. With the U.S. being a key priority market for the Premier League, there is significant focus on driving acquisition and engagement of fans. To help with this growth, the league is seeking to recruit a Digital Marketing Manager to work across the Premier League’s digital marketing and fan development operations in the U.S.

This exciting new role will report into the Head of Digital Partnerships & Distribution, and collaborate with global digital, content, marketing, events and broadcast teams. This role will also work across the broader business to understand the Premier League’s opportunities to help drive U.S. progress.

This role will manage and support on opportunities to grow and broaden the Premier League’s U.S. audience across the League’s owned and operated ecosystem – resulting in stronger and deeper fan engagement not only for the Premier League, but also with our Clubs, broadcast and commercial partners.

The ideal candidate will have a mix of experiences in performance marketing, CRM growth, digital product marketing and paid media. The ideal candidate should have an affinity for sports, be well-versed in digital marketing and consider themselves a self-starter.  
  
**Who we are**  
The Premier League is home to some of the most competitive and compelling football in the world. The League and its Clubs use the power and popularity of the competition to inspire fans, communities and partners in the UK and across the world. The Premier League brings people together from all backgrounds. It is a competition for everyone, everywhere and is available to watch in over 1.2 billion homes in 189 countries.

We have a wide variety of responsibilities. These include organizing the competition and its Handbook as well as managing the centralized broadcast and commercial rights. The work we do in conjunction with the Clubs also goes far beyond the 90 minutes. We support and provide a framework for youth development, we protect the organisation’s intellectual property, support the wider game and community programmes, undertake international development work and liaise with governing bodies and other leagues.

Our hybrid-working model also allows you some variety on your place of work, offering you the chance to work from home on some days each week. Where possible, you will attend the office or site visits in line with our company policy. All staff liaise closely with their line manager to manage their time appropriately and according to their work and team requirements.

### **The role**

The U.S. Digital Marketing Manager will act as the day-to-day point of contact with the global Digital Partnerships and Distribution team. The role will be responsible for the following in collaboration with the U.S. team, and global digital, and audience development teams:

**Performance Marketing & Fan Acquisition**

* Collaborate with global Digital team to plan, execute, and optimize local paid marketing campaigns across digital channels.
* Manage acquisition budgets and media agencies to deliver growth against defined KPIs.
* Continuously test creative, audience segments, messaging, and landing pages to improve performance.
* Develop audience acquisition strategies focused on attracting new Premier League fans across the U.S.

**First-Party Data & CRM Growth**

* Coordinate execution of initiatives designed to increase fan registrations, first party data capture, and CRM database growth.
* Manage campaigns and journeys supporting fan identification and record acquisition.
* Partner with product, analytics, and CRM teams to improve conversion funnels and registration experiences.
* Ensure data collection programs comply with applicable privacy regulations and Premier League standards.

**Lifecycle Marketing**

* Support and execute end-to-end fan lifecycle programs across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other owned channels.
* Build audience segmentation strategies to increase engagement, retention, and reactivation.
* Deliver automated campaigns to drive repeat engagement with Premier League digital products and content.

**Fantasy Premier League & Digital Product Marketing**

* Develop and execute season-long marketing campaigns supporting Fantasy Premier League and App growth in the U.S.
* Drive awareness, acquisition, retention, and engagement for Fantasy Premier League and other digital fan products.
* Collaborate with product, content, creative, and social teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to increase participation and engagement throughout the football season.
* Collaborate with product team to identify product enhancement opportunities.
* Day to day management of U.S. digital hub. Collaborate with Content and Marketing teams to develop season-long content and promotional plan.

**Analytics & Insights**

* Monitor campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations.
* Track and report on key metrics, including:

o Customer acquisition cost (CAC).

o Cost per registration (CPR).

o Conversion rates.

o Engagement and retention metrics.

o Lifetime value indicators.

* Create regular performance reports and executive summaries for stakeholders.
* Leverage data and market insights to inform optimization strategies.
* Manage delivery of regular data and insights reporting to track KPI performance in collaboration with global digital & agencies.  
    
  **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with U.S. marketing, digital, audience development, product, analytics, broadcast and commercial teams. Coordinate with external agencies and platform partners.

At La Ligne (http://www.lalignenyc.com), we believe in the universal appeal of the stripe—always classic, forever chic. ##### Paid Media & Performance Marketing:

* Own day-to-day management of paid social, search, video, and display, partnering with our agency to optimize campaigns, drive revenue, and acquire new customers.
* Monitor and optimize performance, track spend and pacing and recommend budget allocation to the VP of Marketing.
* Lead A/B testing across paid media, email, and SMS, and recommend tests of new ad formats and platforms.
* Partner with the VP of Marketing and creative team on paid media briefs, using performance insights to inform creative testing, aligned with the creative direction set by the Chief Brand Officer.

##### Email, SMS & CRM Marketing:

* Develop, build, and deploy email and SMS campaigns in Klaviyo, partnering with the in-house designer and adapting copy from the brand voice set by the Chief Brand Officer.
* Own the email and SMS calendar within the master marketing calendar, aligned with product launches, promotions, and brand storytelling.
* Build and optimize segmentation and automated journeys, including welcome, first-purchase, abandoned cart, post-purchase, and win-back flows.
* Run retention and lifecycle programs against goals set by the VP of Marketing, including repeat purchase rate and customer lifetime value.
* Coordinate email and SMS with paid and organic social to keep messaging consistent across channels.

##### Agency, Analytics & Reporting:

* Manage our paid media agency day to day against goals set by the VP of Marketing, reviewing results, identifying opportunities, and escalating concerns.
* Partner with eCommerce on tracking and attribution, working toward a single source of truth across Shopify, GA4, and Klaviyo, and with the Marketing Coordinator to bring affiliate and influencer results into reporting.
* Prepare weekly digital performance reports covering acquisition, retention, and channel results, with clear insights and recommendations for the VP of Marketing.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in digital and email marketing, ideally at a fashion, luxury, or premium direct-to-consumer brand
* Hands-on Klaviyo experience across email and SMS, including flows, segmentation, and campaign build
* Hands-on experience building and optimizing campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
* Experience managing a paid media agency day to day against performance targets
* Experience identifying target audiences and developing digital campaign ideas and executions that perform
* Experience designing and reading A/B tests, including judging when results are meaningful
* Experience partnering with e-commerce teams on landing pages and conversion
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Shopify reporting, and HTML and CSS for email
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations

**Salary:** 95K-120K (based on experience)

***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: 123 William Street, New York, NY 10038.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Background**

We’re a tech startup building better industrial equipment monitoring technology. As a data company, relentless accuracy underlies everything we do, and will be the foundation of our outbound sales motion.

**The Role**

We’re looking for creative and ambitious sales reps to join our team in the months following our Series A. You’ll be joining us just in time to set the groundwork for exponential growth over the coming years. This won’t be a standard entry-level sales role where you’ll step into an established system with close guidance.

We know that mass email blasts and generic templates don’t work in this field. Because of this, you will have to be open-minded, willing to fail, and eager to tackle hard problems with persistence. The role will focus on bringing strong leads into the pipeline through thoughtful outbound sales efforts.

We’re also not your typical SaaS company. Having a hardware component to the product will require you to cultivate connections with a wider range of people than if you were selling SaaS only. You’ll talk to everyone from discerning executives concerned with high-level business problems to maintenance technicians looking to save time in the machine room. Building the credibility you’ll need to do well will take time, but will be the groundwork for growing into a top level AE. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to talk.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with the engineering team to learn what makes our product so special, starting with the people who build it.
* Research target industries to create customized outreach strategies and prospect lists.
* Prospect, engage, and qualify leads through outreach strategies: cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, and whatever other channels you believe in.
* Take personal ownership of the top of the funnel process, continuously improving strategies and experimenting with new approaches that you can share with the broader team.
* Collaborate closely with the sales and marketing teams to keep your outreach fresh and on brand.
* Build credibility with industry leaders by being insightful, genuinely curious, and overprepared.
* Schedule discovery meetings between qualified prospects and the rest of the team.
* Take detailed notes on customer feedback to share with the product and leadership teams.
* Be militant about tracking your work in our CRM.
* Charge towards KPIs (appointments set, opportunities created, etc.) and actively contribute to revenue goals. Don’t be afraid to reach out when you’re struggling.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Have 0-1+ years of sales experience ideally in a startup or similarly fast paced role, with a track record of building strong pipelines.
* Take deep personal ownership of your work product and relationships with your teammates.
* Communicate so effectively you inspire prospects to make time for you.
* Are habitually curious and driven by understanding how things work and how they can be improved.
* Ask questions aimed at connecting with people and solving their problems.
* Are able to meet ambiguity with ambition and meticulous attention to detail.

**Compensation**

* Total compensation: $85,000–$100,000 OTE (On-Target Earnings)
* Base salary: $60,000–$70,000
* Commission: $25,000–$30,000

We anticipate this role transitioning into an AE role within the first 12 months of hitting targets. Our AE compensation structure is built to reward selling and is uncapped with large quotas of >20% for closed ACV.

If interested in applying, please send a resume, along with any relevant work samples, and a brief (few sentences) statement about why our company interests you to careers@knaq.io.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

What we offer:

jobs.title: Executive Assistant New
jobs.description:
**Role overview**
-----------------

Newlab is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to support our Global Head of Business and SVP of Operations.

This is an opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys keeping things organized, solving problems, and helping busy teams operate effectively. You'll play an important role in managing schedules, coordinating meetings and travel, tracking follow-ups, and making sure the day-to-day details are taken care of so our leaders can focus on their highest priorities.

You'll work closely with two senior leaders and collaborate with colleagues across Newlab's locations and functions, gaining exposure to a fast-moving business working at the intersection of technology, industry, and economic development.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, comfortable juggling multiple priorities, and eager to learn. We're looking for someone who takes pride in being helpful, follows through on commitments, and brings a positive, solutions-oriented approach to their work.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Executive Support & Calendar Management**

* Manage day-to-day scheduling and calendars for Emilie and Dan, ensuring their time reflects their most important business priorities.
* Help prioritize incoming meeting requests, protect focus time, and ensure schedules are organized around key commitments.
* Look ahead to anticipate scheduling conflicts, upcoming meetings, travel needs, and other logistical considerations.
* Serve as a friendly and responsive point of contact for internal and external stakeholders coordinating with the executives.
* Develop a strong understanding of priorities, proactively identifying competing demands, escalating time-sensitive decisions, and ensuring appropriate attention is given to the highest-impact initiatives.

### **Meeting Coordination, Preparation & Follow-Through**

* Schedule regular team meetings, project reviews, and recurring check-ins across the commercialization and finance/operations groups.
* Coordinate pre-meeting preparation: follow up with meeting owners to ensure agendas, presentations, and background reading are ready and distributed well in advance.
* Identify when a team member needs a quick pre-alignment conversation with Emilie or Dan before a broader review, and get it on the calendar.
* Track meeting outcomes, capture clear next steps, and follow up with team members on their action items to keep projects moving.
* Maintain visibility into key executive commitments, decisions, and follow-ups across meetings, correspondence, and ongoing initiatives, proactively flagging items requiring attention or escalation.

### **Administrative support and logistics**

* Book travel arrangements and build clear, detailed travel itineraries.
* Organize logistics for internal team gatherings, reviews, and occasional offsites.
* Prepare and submit monthly expense reports.
* Serve as an approachable, organized point of contact for colleagues looking to connect with Emilie and Dan.
* Support executive correspondence, including triage, drafting routine communications, coordinating responses, and flagging time-sensitive matters requiring executive attention.

**Qualifications and qualities**
--------------------------------

* **Relevant experience:** Proven experience in an administrative support or executive assistant role, with a track record of supporting busy leaders.
* **Project management mindset:** Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to track multiple moving pieces, coordinate project reviews, and ensure tasks do not slip through the cracks.
* **Diplomatic assertiveness:** Comfortable managing up, nudging colleagues for overdue prep materials, and holding people accountable to deadlines with tact, warmth, and professionalism.
* **Anticipatory acumen:** The habit of looking a week or two ahead to spot calendar crunches, prep gaps, or logistical conflicts before they become problems.
* **Discretion and judgment:** High integrity and sound judgment when handling sensitive business and financial matters.
* **Independent judgment:** Able to balance competing priorities across multiple senior executives, exercise sound judgment, and proactively resolve conflicts with minimal direction.
* **Comfort with technology:** Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, and similar tools, with an interest in learning new systems.
* **Collaborative mindset:** Enjoys working with others, is willing to jump in where needed, and approaches challenges with a positive, can-do attitude.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* We expect this role's base salary to be $67,000 - $75,000 commensurate with the candidate's experience.
* Eligible for a bonus program.
* Comprehensive benefits.

jobs.description:
Description:

***Protomiq Named No. 3165 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 List, the Most Prestigious Ranking of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies***

**About Protomiq**

At Protomiq, we believe that the auto dealerships that win are the ones that create better experiences for their customers. That's why we build technology that helps dealers connect with shoppers, turn interest into action, and drive measurable business results. Thousands of dealerships across North America rely on Protomiq's solutions to engage customers, improve performance, and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving market. From independent dealerships to some of the largest dealer groups and automotive brands in the industry, Protomiq is trusted by dealerships focused on what comes next. If you're excited by innovation, customer impact, and the opportunity to help shape the future of automotive retail, you'll fit right in.

**Working at Protomiq**

At Protomiq, your work matters. We're a team of builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who are passionate about helping our customers succeed. Here, you'll be empowered to move quickly, embrace new ideas, and make a visible impact on the business. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a culture built on collaboration, accountability, and growth.

**Opportunity**

This is a strategic, go-to-market position responsible for integrating events and field marketing into Protomiq’s demand and pipeline generation, sales, account-based marketing, and brand strategies. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong execution skills. The Protomiq Event Marketing Manager owns event strategy and execution and field marketing programs that help meet the company’s monthly demand and pipeline generation goals.

**Responsibilities**

* Own strategy, execution and measurement for all industry events and field marketing programs to drive sales pipeline
* Plan, execute and measure trade show involvement, including large national shows and smaller regional events
* Plan, execute and measure regional roadshows across territories, from location scouting through post-event follow-up
* Align field programs to revenue growth priorities and support three core field marketing motions: New customer acquisition, Customer expansion and Strategic deal acceleration for high-value, competitive opportunities.
* Build and refine repeatable “event-in-a-box” frameworks by segment and use case to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Build and execute targeted field marketing programs, including executive dinners, regional events, prospect and customer roundtables, partner programs, and account-based experiences.
* Track and report on event metrics, including demand and pipeline impact
* Own program execution, including sponsorships, contracts, budgets, vendors, logistics, booth experiences, staffing, promotions, lead capture, and follow-up coordination.
* Manage the event and field marketing budget, reallocating investments toward programs that produce the strongest strategic and financial return.
* Conduct post-event analyses and recommend whether programs should be expanded, redesigned, reduced, or eliminated.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Measurable demand and pipeline creation, pipeline influence, opportunity progression, and booking contributions.
* Effective integration with account-based marketing, sales outreach, demand generation, customer advocacy, and content marketing.
* Strong pre-event planning and post-event follow-up discipline across Marketing and Sales.
* Improved visibility into program performance, audience quality, account engagement, and return on investment.
* Responsible management of budgets, vendors, sponsorships, timelines, and resources.

Requirements:

* 7+ years of experience in B2B event marketing, field marketing, account-based marketing, demand generation, or a related go-to-market role.
* Experience managing a large portfolio of external conferences, trade shows, industry events, and field marketing programs.
* Demonstrated ability to develop event and field marketing strategies for enterprise or complex B2B sales motions.
* An understanding of account-based marketing and how field programs engage buyers, create pipelines, accelerate opportunities, and expand strategic accounts.
* Experience developing executive dinners, roundtables, peer forums, regional programs, and other targeted experiences.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with detailed, hands-on execution across numerous concurrent programs.
* Experience partnering directly with Sales leaders, account executives, business development teams, customer teams, and executives.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, including budget management, investment prioritization, performance analysis, and ROI measurement.
* Experience negotiating sponsorships, vendor agreements, venues, and event services.
* Excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder-influence skills.

**Travel**

* Approximately 25% including occasional evenings and weekends based on event schedule.
