jobs.description:
Job ID: 530508

CRH's Americas Materials division is the leading integrated supplier of aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete and paving and construction services in North America. Our operations span North America with over 29,000 employees at close to 1,660 locations in 45 US States and 2 Canadian provinces.

  

**Job** **Summary**

CRH Americas Materials currently has ~15 different ERP systems (from two separate software vendors - SAP and Viewpoint) and is on a transformational journey, named Project Phoenix, to move to a single ERP environment (SAP) with standardized business processes across the company. This will be a multi-year program with complex change management and implementation plans. The transformation includes the integration or retirement of a full suite of approximately 30 legacy applications spanning finance, operations, safety, HR, environmental, and other functional areas as those business processes move onto SAP S/4HANA.

The Executive Assistant, Event & Logistics Lead plans and supports in-person events for Project Phoenix. Reporting to the VP, Assistant GM, Phoenix Deployment for the project, this role coordinates logistics for training, testing and validation meetings held in multiple waves across multiple locations in the US and Canada. The role will also support the Phoenix team with administrative needs between events.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, budget conscious and comfortable managing large groups, multiple vendors and last-minute changes. Exceptional attention to detail is critical to success in this role.

This is a project-based role with travel of 50% or more.

.

**Job Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Logistics

  

* Plan and coordinate in person events from start to finish, including training, testing and validation sessions.
* Source and manage hotels, venues, catering, AV and other vendors, and coordinate contract review and approval.
* Manage hotel room blocks, meeting space and event materials such as name badges, signage and supplies.
* Provide onsite support during events, including setup, check in and issue resolution.
* Partner with IT and AV teams to make sure technology is ready for each event.

Attendee Management & Communications

  

* Maintain accurate attendee lists and manage registration, confirmations and follow up.
* Partner with Business Unit leaders to confirm attendee lists and coordinate changes.
* Draft and send attendee communications, including invitations, logistics details, agendas and reminders.

Budget & Administration

  

* Track event spending against budget and look for ways to reduce costs.
* Review and process vendor invoices and expenses accurately and on time.

Project Phoenix Team Support

  

* Support the Project Phoenix team with administrative needs.
* Manage calendars and schedule meetings and calls, including recurring team meetings and calls with Business Unit leaders and consulting partners.
* Arrange team meals, catering and working lunches as needed.
* Work with other assistants across CRH to coordinate schedules, meetings and events.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify and plan all business activities for each value stream related to technical cutover for assigned deployment waves.
* Work with the Data and Solutions Team to confirm technical readiness for business activities, including the SAP solution and integrated applications.
* Help the business execute the cutover checklist and track readiness status as the team approaches go-live.
* Engage directly with the business to provide direction and support for cutover activities.
* Support war room operations, including issue logging, triage, and status reporting during cutover windows.
* Monitor plan through SAP ramp up and start of Crawl, Walk, Run business processes.
* Maintain cutover documentation and provide regular status updates to the Business Readiness & Cutover Lead.
* Coordinate with project managers on testing, data migration, IT system cutover, and legacy business process transition activities.
* Document the cutover plan for assigned applications/workstreams, including dependencies and data readiness requirements.
* Plan the physical and virtual resources required for cutover activities and support legacy system shutdown coordination.
* Performs additional job duties as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Five or more years of executive administrative or event planning experience, including events of 100+ attendees.
* Experience negotiating and managing hotel, venue and vendor contracts.
* Experience managing budgets and invoicing.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Experience with Concur travel and expense preferred.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to last-minute changes and work both independently and as part of a team.
* Professional presence and the ability to work with executives, consultants and vendors.

**Work Environment**

  

* Travel of 50% or more, often for one to four weeks at a time.
* Early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends may be required around events.
* Ability to lift and move event supplies up to 25 lbs.
* When not traveling, the role is preferred to be based in Atlanta, Georgia (TBD).

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training.

Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. **Account Manager**

**Location: Atlanta Georgia (Remote)**

Swift Workforce AI Inc. is an Atlanta startup founded by Catalyst by Wellstar, the venture and innovation arm of the 13 hospital, ~35,000 employee Wellstar Health System, and Alloy Partners, a leading startup studio. Our mission is to improve work-life balance for the healthcare workforce, starting with nurses, and to improve the financial sustainability of the organizations that employ them. We achieve our mission through Swift™, the first agentic AI copilot for scheduling that autonomously executes complex scheduling and staffing workflows in real-time so providers can do more of what they became providers to do: care for patients. With over 10,000 users, Swift reduces scheduling workflows by more than 80%, increases productivity, and improves work~life balance.

We are seeking an experienced Account Manager that will report to the CEO. In this role you’ll manage current customers and new onboard healthcare systems and and other healthcare delivery organizations. You will be customer-facing and responsible for building and maintaining relationships, eliciting feedback, identifying opportunities, providing customer support, solving problems, and helping close renewal contracts.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Own the Customer Experience:** Lead onboarding and implementation for customers. As part of customer onboarding and management, you will uncover opportunities, often by discovering customer problems, and will act as the liaison between Swift’s technical team and each customer to solve problems an ensure an awesome (!) experience.

* **Support Sales & Growth:** Assist with sales initiatives, marketing initiatives, reporting, and management functions.

  
**Requirements**  

* You must be live and work in the Greater Atlanta area and can travel regularly to customer sites (primarily in Georgia to start, but nationally as we grow). This may include travel for in-person onboarding sessions at hospitals during off-business hours (e.g. 6:30am, 8pm etc.)

* PMP certification is a big plus.

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Hybrid work model (remote + in-office in Atlanta’s Tech Square)
* A seat at the table in a fast-growing, mission-driven company

* *Subject to successfully completing an evaluation period*

Let’s help the care givers that help so many…

At Swift, your work will directly impact the lives of providers, care teams, and health system financial sustainability. If you’re ready to help us deliver flexible, intelligent solutions to healthcare’s frontline, we want to meet you!

Swift Workforce AI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All hiring and employment decisions are made on merit, performance, competence, and our business needs. **Inside Sales Rep, Founding Memberships (Sandy Springs, GA)**  
  
Full-time or part-time. $15-16/hour plus $10 per founding membership you sign. Start as soon as possible.  
  
We're opening a brand new Scenthound in Sandy Springs, and we need someone to fill it with members before the doors open.  
  
**WHO WE ARE**  
Scenthound isn't your everyday grooming shop. We focus on dog health and wellness, not just haircuts. Our membership model gives dogs routine care for their Skin, Coat, Ears, Nails and Teeth (S.C.E.N.T.). Our team runs six Scenthound locations across metro Atlanta, and Sandy Springs will be our seventh.  
  
Our North Star: we enrich the connection between people and their dogs.  
Our values: Dog First. One Pack. Bring Love. Seek Growth. Make A Difference.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
This is our first hire for Sandy Springs, and one of the most important. Before we open, you'll turn interested dog owners into founding members. Every member you sign is a dog we'll care for on day one, and a strong opening sets the store up for years. Once we open, you'll welcome the members you signed and keep selling memberships alongside the store team.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO**  

* Call and text new leads fast, and walk them through a founding membership
* Follow up with people who aren't ready yet until they're a yes or a clear no
* Teach dog parents why routine wellness care matters, so the membership makes sense to them
* Get out in the neighborhood: local businesses, apartment communities, dog parks and events
* Sign members up and keep their profiles clean in our booking system
* Track your numbers each week and share what's working
* After we open: book appointments, run check-in and check-out, handle the cash drawer, and keep members happy and active

  
**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  

* Hundreds of founding members signed by opening day, with you leading the charge
* Every lead gets a quick follow-up on every day you work
* Members who show up for their first visit and stay

  
**WHERE THIS CAN GO**

**About GoMedAid**

GoMedAid is a healthcare technology platform developed by CareBridge Technologies to help organizations improve communication, client engagement, and visibility throughout enrollment and care coordination.

Our initial focus includes organizations helping individuals navigate Medicaid waiver and home care enrollment. GoMedAid helps teams communicate next steps, coordinate documents and follow-ups, and keep clients and families informed.

We are seeking a relationship-driven professional who understands the healthcare organizations involved in these processes and can introduce GoMedAid to prospective customers and partners.

**The opportunity**

This fractional business development role combines direct outreach, relationship building, software demonstrations, sales follow-up, and conference representation.

Georgia-based candidates are preferred. We also welcome applicants in neighboring states who have meaningful Georgia healthcare connections or relevant Medicaid waiver and care coordination experience.

This position may suit an experienced healthcare liaison, provider relations professional, case management professional, or healthcare technology salesperson seeking a flexible part-time opportunity.

**What you will do**

* Identify and engage decision-makers at home care agencies, case management agencies, care coordination organizations, and other relevant healthcare businesses.
* Use existing relationships and targeted outreach to introduce GoMedAid.
* Arrange and deliver product demonstrations after training.
* Follow up with prospects and help convert interest into paid subscriptions.
* Develop relationships with healthcare associations and potential channel partners.
* Maintain accurate prospect records, next steps, and sales activity.
* Share customer feedback to help improve our messaging and product positioning.
* Represent GoMedAid at approximately six conferences or industry events nationwide each year.

Conference responsibilities include booth setup and breakdown, organizing signage and marketing materials, speaking with attendees, demonstrating the platform, capturing qualified leads, and following up after events.

**What we are looking for**

* Relevant experience in healthcare business development, provider relations, community outreach, case management, care coordination, or healthcare technology sales.

* Ability to reach healthcare decision-makers and build professional relationships.

**Compensation and travel**

* Guaranteed base pay of **$35 per hour**.

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a brief explanation of:

* Your experience with Medicaid waivers, care coordination, healthcare agencies, or healthcare technology.
* The types of healthcare organizations and decision-makers you have worked with.
* Your experience generating business, arranging demonstrations, or closing sales.

jobs.title: Learning Center Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Learning Center Operations Coordinator provides essential administrative, operational, and classroom support to ensure the effective daily functioning of Indelible Impressions Learning Center. This position serves as a welcoming first point of contact for families, visitors, and staff while assisting with office operations, classroom staffing coordination, substitute arrangements, and classroom support.

Working under the direction of the Center Director, the Coordinator helps maintain a safe, organized, positive, and nurturing environment that supports children, families, and employees.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Front Office & Administrative Support

* Serve as a friendly, welcoming, and professional first point of contact for parents, visitors, and staff.
* Answer incoming telephone calls, respond to routine inquiries, and direct communications appropriately.
* Assist with administrative correspondence, filing, data entry, and maintaining accurate records.
* Support parent communications and distribute center announcements as directed.
* Maintain an organized, professional, and welcoming front office environment.
* Assist the Center Director with administrative projects and daily operational needs.

2. Classroom Coverage & Staffing Coordination

* Assist with developing and maintaining daily classroom coverage schedules to support adequate staffing.
* Coordinate employee breaks and classroom relief coverage.
* Contact approved substitute teachers and support staff to arrange coverage for planned and unexpected absences.
* Monitor anticipated staffing needs and communicate potential coverage gaps to the Center Director.
* Maintain accurate records of substitute arrangements, staffing schedules, and coverage changes.
* Assist with coordinating classroom assignments and schedule adjustments as directed.
* Support compliance with applicable staff-to-child ratios and licensing requirements.

3. Classroom & Instructional Support

* Provide temporary classroom coverage and assist teaching staff as needed, consistent with required qualifications and licensing regulations.
* Support teachers with classroom activities, transitions, and daily routines.
* Assist with maintaining a safe, clean, and organized classroom environment.
* Provide additional classroom support during employee breaks, absences, and periods of increased operational need.
* Reinforce established classroom procedures, safety expectations, and center policies.
* Communicate classroom concerns or operational needs promptly to the Center Director.

4. Supplies, Inventory & Resource Management

* Monitor classroom and office supply levels and identify replenishment needs.
* Coordinate ordering and purchasing of approved supplies within established budgets and procedures.
* Receive, organize, and distribute supplies to classrooms and appropriate staff.
* Maintain basic inventory records and assist with monitoring supply expenditures.
* Communicate supply shortages and anticipated needs to the Center Director.

5. Customer Service & Team Support

* Foster positive, respectful, and professional relationships with families, children, and staff.
* Assist with resolving routine questions and direct sensitive matters to the Center Director.
* Support effective communication between the front office and classroom staff.
* Demonstrate flexibility, dependability, and a willingness to assist where needed.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding children, families, employees, and center operations.
* Promote a collaborative, supportive, and service-oriented workplace culture.

Minimum Qualifications

* High school diploma or GED required; associate degree or coursework in early childhood education, business administration, or a related field preferred.
* Two years of administrative, customer service, childcare, or related experience preferred.
* Experience in an early childhood learning center or educational environment strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, and basic office technology.
* Strong organizational, scheduling, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to changing staffing needs.
* Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, dependability, and sound judgment.
* Ability to meet all applicable background check, training, and childcare licensing requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience coordinating employee schedules or substitute staffing.
* Familiarity with Georgia DECAL childcare licensing requirements.
* Experience assisting in early childhood classrooms.
* Current CPR and First Aid certification.
* Experience with childcare management or parent communication software.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

* Excellent customer service and relationship-building skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational ability.
* Ability to communicate effectively with parents, staff, and leadership.
* Ability to work independently while following established procedures.
* Flexibility to transition between administrative and classroom responsibilities.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Commitment to child safety and quality early childhood education.

Physical & Work Requirements

* Ability to perform work in both office and classroom environments.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, sit, and move throughout the center.
* Ability to assist with age-appropriate classroom activities and child supervision.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation, when necessary for essential duties.
* Availability to work scheduled hours and provide operational support during peak arrival, departure, and classroom transition periods.

Pay: $19.00 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Account Executive or Client Services Supervisor (Account Lead)

**Role Type:** Hybrid Account Support & Job Trafficker

**Time Allocation:** 50% Job Workflow (Traffic) | 40% Client Admin | 10% Financial Support

**Position Summary:**

The Account Coordinator serves as the operational hub for their assigned account team. In this integrated role, you are responsible for both the administrative health of the client relationship and the end-to-end job trafficking of non-digital solutions engagements. You act as the bridge between Client Services and other teams, ensuring that work is scoped, scheduled, routed, and delivered on time and error-free.

Account Coordinators love the details. They want to know how things work and want to make sure they always work the way they are supposed to. An Account Coordinator at HDMZ is an entry-level position but it's a role that has a big impact on our success everyday. Account Coordinators love to collaborate, learn about our clients’ businesses and customers, build relationships with clients, embrace processes, are always curious and feel a heightened sense to not let others down. Account Coordinators have a passion for life sciences, marketing and the creative process that only an Agency environment can bring. Must be intelligent. And fun. And effective. No divas or delicate egos, please.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with internal and external partners to ensure all client requests are completed in a timely manner
* Manage the team status reports, meeting agendas and contact reports, and update them on a regular basis
* Create and build presentations for client meetings
* Responsible for daily traffic, job opening and management
* Implement and manage projects and related tasks
* Proofing and QA
* To be curious about how to solve problems in a way that respects the objective to be achieved as well as the client/agency relationship
* Be a champion for the agency and for the client by knowing how to navigate the messy human relationships that can cause conflict if not careful

**Responsibility detail:**

* **Job Traffic & Workflow (The "Traffic" Role)**

  + **Schedule Ownership:** **Create and manage daily timelines for print, branding, and content projects. You are responsible for knowing exactly where every job is for the client team you support.**
  + **Routing & Quality Control:** **Own the internal routing process. Ensure all creative work is reviewed by the appropriate leads (Strategy, Creative, Scientific) before it reaches the Client Supervisor or Account Lead.**
  + **Asset Management:** **Act as the central librarian for project assets. proactively gather and organize high-res logos, images, and copy decks so the creative team has everything they need before they start working and ensure they’re archived and available via the approved agency platforms and drives.**
  + **Vendor Coordination:** **Work with Account Leads and Dept Heads to manage specifications and deadlines for external vendors (printers, trade show partners), ensuring files are released correctly and on time.**
* **Client Administration & Support**

  + **Meeting Management:** **Own the logistics for all internal and client meetings. Most importantly, capture and distribute Contact Reports (meeting minutes) within 24 hours, clearly identifying "next steps" and action items for the team.**
  + **Client Correspondence:** **Draft routine client updates, timeline alerts, and file deliveries under the supervision of the Account Lead.**
  + **Presentation Support:** **Assist in building and formatting slide decks for client presentations, ensuring they match agency brand standards.**
* **Financial Hygiene**

  + **Budget Tracking:** **Work hand in hand with the Account Lead to monitor and track billable activity to budget.**

**What you are not responsible for:**

* **Technical PM:** You do not manage complex digital builds (websites/apps). These are handled by the COO/Digital PM.
* **Strategic Planning**: You support the strategy, but you do not write the strategic briefs or annual plans.
* **Staffing Allocation:** You request resources, but you do not make the final decision on who works on the project (that sits with the Team Lead and Account Lead).

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree (preferred in the sciences)
* Agency internship experience is strongly preferred.
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail
* Strong communication skills, able to speak and write clearly and persuasively.
* Relationship builder
* Aptitude for learning new skills (both technical and organic) and procedures.
* Self-motivated with strong follow-through
* Adaptable to change and able to multitask
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms)

At **Millennium Hotels & Resorts**, we are driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and delivering exceptional hospitality experiences across a global portfolio. Our corporate teams play a critical role in supporting our properties, driving strategy, and enabling operational success.

Our corporate office serves as the strategic and operational hub for Millennium Hotels & Resorts, supporting the hotels across multiple regions and brands. jobs.description:
**Work. Serve. Thrive.**

Imagine a place where your talent can make a meaningful difference in peoples' lives. Working at Feeding America is a uniquely rewarding experience in which our employees work together as vital parts of a much larger mission. We are innovative, mission-focused, diverse, collaborative, values-driven and focused on results.

Feeding America is the nation’s largest charity and the leading domestic hunger-relief charity in the United States. Our mission is to feed America's hungry through a nationwide network of member food banks and engage our country in the fight to end hunger.

This is a **hybrid position based out of Feeding America’s Chicago office location**. At Feeding America, we believe in offering a flexible work environment. Employees can be in the office an average of 2 - 3 days a week (when not travelling for work) and work from home on other days. Employees also have access to a 30-day “work anywhere” program during the course of each calendar year that can be combined with PTO and/or holidays.

Learn more about Feeding America here.

**The Opportunity**

The Manager, Integrated Marketing – Prospects/Email is responsible for cultivating and converting digitally acquired prospects into loyal donors and works in collaboration across Integrated Marketing to execute audience-centric marketing strategies. This role translates audience motivations, beliefs and barriers into marketing strategies, proactively experimenting with segment-specific approaches, and helping teams adopt what works. Email, SMS and lead generation serve as core channels in support of integrated campaign initiatives, with this role ensuring they work together to enhance the donor journey and deliver cohesive, personalized experiences that drive engagement, conversion and retention.

**Compensation**  
  
Here at Feeding America national organization, equality is central to our mission and is an integral part of our compensation policies and structures. As such, we maintain transparent salary ranges and clearly defined practices for how our team, including new hire salary offers, moves through these ranges. You can expect us to offer the best salary up front based on these clearly defined pay practices with little room for negotiation. We make exceptions for highly experienced (multiple years of at-level experience) new hires in accordance with our pay practices. Once hired, employees have the opportunity to progress through salary ranges via regular merit increases and step promotions.  
  
**Salary Range: $98,670 - $103,670 Based on Experience.**

**Benefits:** A comprehensive list of benefits available to full-time employees can be found**here****.**  
  
**Responsibilities:**

Campaign Strategy & Execution

* Leads the development of marketing strategies for digitally acquired prospects and early-stage donors, with email and SMS as primary activation channels.
* Translates audience insights into compelling, timely and relevant engagements that move supporters through the donor lifecycle.
* Applies proprietary attitudinal segmentation to differentiated messaging, creative, offers and donor journeys, while managing campaign calendars and testing plans to optimize performance and donor experience/
* Ensures messaging is consistent and aligned across channels, collaborating with creative, data and fundraising teams.

Cross-Functional Integration & Innovation

* Serves as the internal advocate for the prospect audience segment in digital channels, ensuring their needs and behaviors inform campaign design and channel mix.
* Proactively develops hypotheses and tests segment-specific messaging, creative, offers and donor-journey approaches to improve engagement, conversion and retention.
* Partners with research, analytics and marketing technology teams to enable segment activation, document hypotheses and results, develop reporting tools, and scale effective practices across teams.
* Translates test results into clear recommendations, documented best practices and repeatable playbooks that help teams adopt what works.

Collaboration & Operational Excellence

* Collaborates with peers across integrated marketing, digital media, development and marketing technology to ensure integrated execution and shared goals.
* Coordinates with external vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure flawless execution, brand consistency and innovation.
* Supports strategic planning, budgeting and resource allocation in partnership with the Director of Integrated Marketing.
* Collaborates effectively across teams and functions, ensuring alignment, transparency and shared accountability in support of integrated MarCom goals.
* Demonstrates operational excellence by managing timelines, deliverables and processes with attention to detail, adaptability and a solutions-oriented mindset.
* Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, documenting best practices and identifying opportunities to streamline and scale.

Performance Optimization & Innovation

* Champions a culture of experimentation, leveraging A/B testing and iterative learning to improve conversion and retention.
* Stays current on digital marketing trends, tools and best practices to enhance campaign effectiveness and donor engagement.
* Identifies opportunities to expand automation, personalization and lifecycle marketing strategies across email and SMS.

**Required Competencies, Experience and Certifications:**

jobs.title: Entry Level Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: Industrious***  
***24 E. Washington St Suite 875 Chicago, IL 60602***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

We are at the forefront of surgical innovation and highly skilled in minimally invasive surgical techniques such as advanced laparoscopic surgery, transanal endoscopic microsurgery (TEM), robotic surgery and endoscopic procedures.  
  
The section's educational endeavors focus on training the next generation of colon and rectal surgeons. The colon and rectal surgery fellowship program trains surgeons in the multidisciplinary care of patients with colon and rectal pathologies, provides opportunities for high quality research, and prepares the surgeons for pursuit of academic careers. Fellows can expect a central role in comprehensive multidisciplinary patient management and training in innovative approaches such as robotic surgery and transanal endoscopic microsurgery — the leading edge of colon and rectal surgical care in the 21st century.

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the CEO, responsible for managing the CEO’s time, priorities, communications, and logistics while also owning the day-to-day operation of L5’s Chicago office. This role combines high level executive support with hands-on office management and administrative coordination across the business. **Operations & Events Coordinator**

**About the Role**

This is a varied, hands-on position for someone who enjoys staying busy, solving practical problems, and seeing their work make a difference.

You might spend one day preparing event materials and organizing supplies, another picking up items around Los Angeles, and another helping set up technology or supporting an event on-site.

**You’ll have established tools, checklists, and direction to work from. You do need to take responsibility for your part, communicate clearly, and follow through.

Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why "I love the people here" is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

**The Role**

We are looking for an exceptional individual to own GoGuardian's channel partner business within a defined region. This role combines data-driven decision making, partner relationship management, and business development. You will bring significant experience working with resellers and distributors in the educational technology sector, and you'll be a self-starter and energy amplifier with a proven ability to turn strategy into regional growth.

You will own your region's partner portfolio end to end, from joint business plans and pipeline to onboarding new partners and resolving channel conflict. You'll work alongside our Channel Operations Specialist, who runs the operational side of our indirect business, so your time stays focused on partners, pipeline, and results. Your success will be measured by the strength of your partner relationships and the growth of your region's pipeline and bookings.

This role will live within close driving distance of a major Southeast airport as this role will represent us at field events requiring travel up to 30% of the time.

**What You'll Do**

* **Regional Partner Ownership & Development:** Own the portfolio of resellers, distributors, and solution partners in your region, building strong relationships between partner and GoGuardian reps and leadership. Lead new partner onboarding and grow existing partners' capabilities and performance.
* **Data-Driven Performance & Business Reviews:** Analyze data on regional performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead partner business reviews to evaluate results, address gaps, and drive improvement.
* **Pipeline Development & Forecasting:** Build and manage a robust pipeline across your regional partner network, supporting accurate forecasting, execution of joint business plans, and consistent growth in bookings.
* **Sales Alignment & Account Planning:** Drive sales planning, account mapping, and partner alignment with GoGuardian's regional sales teams to identify opportunities and generate pipeline.
* **Channel Program Execution:** Lead regional execution of channel programs, including partner SPIFs, events, and collaborative initiatives that drive partner engagement and business growth.
* **Escalations, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:** Manage regional partner escalations, customer satisfaction, and channel conflicts while partnering with Channel Operations, Sales, and cross-functional GoGuardian teams. Collaborate with fellow Regional CAMs to drive shared success. Stay current on industry trends and adapt regional strategies to meet evolving market demands.

**Who You Are**

* Related experience in channel account management, business development, or partner management, with a strong emphasis on resellers and distributors.
* Proven expertise in data analysis and decision-making leveraging AI. You can interpret large datasets and turn them into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
* Experience with performance metrics, incentive programs, and pipeline management. You're comfortable using dashboards and reports to communicate results and progress.
* A track record of owning a territory or partner portfolio and growing its bookings.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to present complex data and strategies clearly, from partner sellers to senior leadership.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset who drives initiatives independently and rallies cross-functional teams to achieve results.
* Proven track record of building strong relationships and working collaboratively with partners to drive mutual business success.
* High energy and passion for technology and education. You're excited about amplifying partner success and bringing innovative solutions to schools and districts.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay, complete health insurance, 401(k) matching, and an employee equity plan.
* Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a paid year-end holiday break.
* A robust catalog of benefits that support your professional growth and personal wellbeing, including work from home funds, fertility & adoption reimbursement, and more…

*Plus the intangible:*

* A varied and challenging role in an innovative, global company.
* Supportive, driven colleagues who have your back and share your passion.

The typical total on target earnings (OTE) for this position is $115,000 – $135,000. The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for this position and your pay will be determined by a variety of factors, including your primary work location, skills, qualifications and experience. Additional benefits information is listed on our careers page.

Please share this with your friends or co-workers who may be interested in working at GoGuardian! We have multiple openings and are always looking for talente

new_jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: Blank Spaces- 929 Colorado Ave, Santa Monica, CA.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, and three or more years coordinating a program with many stakeholders.

Fluent with AI tools in everyday work, such as drafting and summarizing documents, preparing meeting notes and keeping plans and trackers current, and keen to find where they can take over routine coordination.

Bloom Energy is looking for a driven, curious, and results-oriented **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to help identify and develop new business opportunities across our target markets.

As an SDR, you will be on the front line of Bloom’s go-to-market organization, researching strategic accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and engaging prospects around some of the most important energy challenges businesses face today. You’ll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to create qualified pipeline and introduce customers to Bloom Energy’s solutions.

This role is ideal for someone who is competitive, comfortable speaking with senior business and operational leaders, and eager to build a career in enterprise sales.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Research and prioritize target accounts based on factors such as company size, facility footprint, geography, industry, energy requirements, and overall fit.
* Identify and engage key stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Facilities, Engineering, Sustainability, Procurement, and executive leadership.
* Execute thoughtful, multi-channel outbound campaigns using phone, email, LinkedIn, and other prospecting methods.
* Develop personalized outreach based on account-specific business drivers rather than relying solely on high-volume, generic messaging.
* Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities to understand account fit, business needs, timing, stakeholders, and potential energy requirements.
* Schedule qualified meetings and facilitate a clean handoff to the appropriate Account Executive.
* Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, prioritize prospects, and expand engagement within strategic accounts.
* Maintain accurate and detailed prospecting, qualification, and activity information in Salesforce and other sales systems.
* Follow up quickly and thoughtfully on inbound inquiries, marketing-generated leads, events, campaigns, and prospect responses.
* Continuously develop your knowledge of Bloom Energy, the energy industry, customer use cases, and the business challenges facing commercial and industrial customers.
* Contribute to a high-performance SDR culture focused on accountability, collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
    
    
  What We’re Looking For
  + Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  + Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  + Comfortable making outbound calls and engaging prospective customers by phone.
  + Ability to research complex organizations and translate research into relevant, personalized outreach.
  + Strong organization and attention to detail, particularly when managing multiple accounts and prospects simultaneously.

new_jobs.description:
### **About Goodie AI:**

Goodie helps leading brands win AI search. As billions of people use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI systems to discover products and make buying decisions, brands need a way to understand and influence how they’re represented.

Goodie gives teams a full AI control plane: real-time visibility into how AI models speak about their brand and products, how competitors show up, and an optimization engine to improve visibility and performance. This category didn’t exist two years ago – we were early, and we’re defining it.

We’re backed by strong investors, trusted by category-leading customers, and scaling fast. We’re hiring curious, ambitious builders to help shape the future of AI search.

**What we’re looking for:**  
You’ll own research from the first question to the published story: run the study, share it, and pitch it to the publications that matter. You are someone who loves digging into data and isn’t waiting to be told what’s next.

You’ll have the support of a team around you, plus the freedom to run your own studies and help our research reach a wider audience. You’ll report to the Director of Growth Marketing, shaping the research roadmap.

**What you’ll do:**

*Run the research*

* Write a one-page study brief before any work starts: the question, hypothesis, data needed, method, and target publish date.
* Define the data set each study needs.
* Request data from our research team, then clean, analyze, and check it.
* Write up what the data shows and what it does not, with a source and date on every number.
* Document each study’s method so the next one is faster.

*Write and publish the findings*

* Turn each study into content for marketing materials, blog, social, email, and other.
* Work with our organic team on drafting and publishing.
* Keep a regular publishing schedule for research across our channels.
* Write research-led pages for the Goodie website, using findings from our studies as proof points so the copy is backed by our own data.

*Pitch the story*

* Write two or three pitch angles per study, each tied to a publication’s recent coverage.
* Build a target list of journalists and editors for every study, and prepare the data and charts they will ask for.
* Send pitches with support from our PR team, and follow up.
* Track every placement, link, and mention in one log.

*Measure and report*

* Set success metrics, a threshold, and a stop date for every study before it publishes.
* Report on each study’s performance from web analytics.
* Recommend what to repeat, change, or stop.

*Beyond the research*

* Contribute to our regular blog publishing, including thought leadership pieces, while studies are in progress, so our publishing rhythm never stalls.
* Prepare content for online and offline events.
* Research competitors and topics to spot gaps that could become your next study.

**What you have:**

* 2+ years experience in marketing, consulting, research, journalism, or analytics.
* Strong writing. You can explain a finding plainly and say clearly what the data cannot support.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets and the habit of checking numbers before they go out.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) for research, analysis, and drafting, and the judgment to check what they produce before it goes out.
* Curiosity about AI search and how answer engines choose their sources.

**Bonus / nice-to-haves:**

* Experience pitching or working with media, or a clear willingness to learn it.
* Original research that earned media coverage.
* Direct AEO/GEO experience.
* Startup background.

They act as a central operational point of contact for complex client programs, coordinating with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders. Behind the scenes, they turn what they hear from clients into clear plans, early risk signals, and improved operational processes.

In this self-serve model, clients design and execute consumer research alongside quinn, our always-on AI research partner. Your mission is to serve as their ultimate technical enabler and safety net investigating complex platform issues, triaging escalations, and evaluating AI-generated outputs to ensure seamless research execution.

Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who loves digging under the hood? Are you adept at AI, sharp enough to spot a logic flaw or hallucination, and energized by empowering others? If so, we’d love to talk with you!

**What you will be doing:**
---------------------------

* **DIQ Support & AI Escalation Management:** Manage and resolve complex escalations from users or quinn by skillfully utilizing our platform, ticketing systems, and AI tools. Act as the critical bridge between users and Product.
* **Technical & Research Flow Troubleshooting:** Investigate unexpected platform behaviors to isolate software bugs, user error, or flawed survey logic — coordinating seamlessly with Product to drive swift, decisive resolutions.
* **AI Output & Questionnaire Quality Assurance:** Systematically review quinn-generated outputs for technical precision, identifying hallucinations, data inconsistencies, or logic gaps in automated questionnaire designs.
* **Client Empowerment & Enablement:** Take a service- and education-minded approach to every interaction. Educate and train customers on platform capabilities, empowering them to build and run research independently.
* **Platform Mastery, Process Improvement & Product Feedback:** Rapidly master our evolving platform and act as a crucial feedback loop. Analyze support queue trends to recommend workflow optimizations, systematically capturing client friction points to advocate for targeted platform enhancements.

**Who you are:**
----------------

The ideal candidate is a tech-savvy problem solver who understands market research survey mechanics and thrives on empowering customers in an AI-driven SaaS environment.

* T**ech-Savvy Problem Solver:** You have a deep technical aptitude, strong analytical skills, a drive to find solutions, and a passion for untangling complex software issues.
* **Market Research & Survey Flow Aptitude:** You possess a solid understanding of market research fundamentals and survey flow mechanics—including question routing, skip patterns, piping, quota definitions, and screening criteria—allowing you to quickly diagnose flaws in implementation.
* **AI Adept with a Critical Eye:** You leverage AI tools effectively while maintaining a sharp eye for detail to spot hallucinations, mis-statements, or logic gaps in AI-generated outputs.
* **Education-Minded Communicator:** You translate complex technical nuances, bug investigations, and survey workflows into clear, actionable guidance for clients and internal engineering teams.
* **Agile & Process-Oriented:** You thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment, constantly seeking ways to improve support workflows, knowledge base resources, and customer success metrics.
* **Education & Background:** Degree in Information Systems, Business, a related analytical field, or equivalent practical experience in technical support, SaaS enablement, or market research operations.

**Benefits of working at quantilope:**
--------------------------------------

Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?  

Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.  
Wellness is key: We offer full benefits (health, dental, and vision) as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.  
* Diverse & inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.
Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with a 401k program and a 3.5% annual match.  
* Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties.. .where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

  
Compensation: $75k - $86k base + 10% bonus

  

**Über uns**
------------

Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI-driven solutions to support data-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300+ brands.  
  
As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.  
  
Join us and let's see what we can build together!

* Experience managing a paid media agency day to day against performance targets
* Experience identifying target audiences and developing digital campaign ideas and executions that perform
* Experience designing and reading A/B tests, including judging when results are meaningful
* Experience partnering with e-commerce teams on landing pages and conversion
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Shopify reporting, and HTML and CSS for email
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations

**Salary:** 95K-120K (based on experience)

new_jobs.description:
***Launch Your Sales Career at Bisnow | 2027 BDR Class | July 6 Start***

***Bisnow is opening early recruitment for our 2027 Business Development Representative class — hiring hungry, high-potential candidates across multiple major US markets for a July 6, 2027 start date.***  
  
***We welcome upcoming Spring 2027 graduates, recent graduates, and early-career professionals with 0–1 years of experience from any background in sales. No prior real estate experience required — just strong communication skills, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in B2B media sales.***  
  
***This is a first job that becomes a career. You’ll partner with clients across the commercial real estate industry, be in the room at 400+ live events a year, and follow a clear path from BDR to Business Manager in a culture that genuinely promotes from within. Expected in office 3 - 4 days per week. Office location: 123 William Street, New York, NY 10038.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.

We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

* Competitive compensation structure
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Maternity and paternity leaves
* 401K
* Flexible Spending Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Health Savings Account
* **Unlimited Vacation Days**
* 7 days paid sick leave
* 9 paid Holidays
* Referral Bonus Program
* You’ll get to work with incredibly smart, passionate, driven, ambitious, kind, caring and mindful people and will rarely experience an overload of policies, bureaucracy or toxicity (the latter, we do not tolerate).

Uncapped monthly bonuses tied to a performance-based step scale: the more you close, the more you earn.

Anticipated start date: July 6th, 2027

new_jobs.description:
**ICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR - Davis Center at the Harlem Meer**

**HAR SFM, LLC**

*LOCATION: New York, New York*

**DEPARTMENT: OPERATIONS**

**REPORTS TO: GENERAL MANAGER**

**STATUS: FULL-TIME (EXEMPT)**

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Davis Center at the Harlem Meer is a brand new state-of-the-art recreational facility in New York City's iconic Central Park featuring a 1.25 acre outdoor area which houses an elliptical pool (280' x 120') that converts to a .75 acre public green during the spring & fall and features a full-size ice rink in the winter months. A 34,000 sq ft adjacent building houses locker rooms, public restrooms, and a large indoor gathering space to support all outdoor programming. Described by Manhattan Borough President Mark Levine as "one of the most important parks equity projects for the City in decades", the new Davis Center is the capstone project of the Central Park Conservancy's 40-year effort to restore Central Park and will serve as the hub for recreational and community programming in the area. You will be joining a championship level team focused on fun, fulfillment and service built to enrich the community as well as your career and personal growth.

Davis Center at the Harlem Meer is a managed facility by HAR SFM, LLC, a Sports Facilities Companies (SFC) company. SFC is the nation's leading resource for managing and developing sports, recreation, wellness, and events facilities. We provide a highly collaborative and supportive culture that raises our team members to new levels of career growth. Together, we will carve a path in a hyper- growing industry where you will enjoy the journey and learn from the industry's best while having some fun.

SFC has been awarded national recognition as a Top Workplace and is considered a workplace of choice. Our mission-focused company is highly entrepreneurial, team-oriented with a culture centered on collaboration, accountability, excellence, and service. We are growing rapidly and looking for high performers at every level to grow with us.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Ice Operations Coordinator will work in coordination with the General Manager to support the overall management and maintenance of the facility. This position provides direction and training to front-line supervisors and part-time team members. This role will work closely with individual leaders of each program as well as other internal departments to successfully accomplish these responsibilities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO THE FOLLOWING:**

* Provides support to front-line managers/supervisors to promote compliance with SFM policies and additional applicable laws
* Assist in coordinating daily operations of the ice venue, including ice maintenance, scheduling, and facility operations
* Supports the training and day-to-day guidance of ice resurfacer operators to ensure a safe, skateable ice surface and adherence to operational standards
* Ensure the ice surface is properly maintained, including ice resurfacing, checking for quality, and addressing any issues promptly
* Coordinate the setup and teardown of events, including hockey games, public skating sessions, and private rentals
* Coordinate communications with event or rental owners pre and post event
* Participates in planning/strategic meetings
* Conduct regular inspections of the facility to ensure cleanliness, safety, and compliance with health and safety regulations
* Coordinate with Maintenance Team Members to address any repairs or upgrades needed for the facility and equipment
* Support proper cash handling procedures
* Supports hiring, training, and education of Team Members on proper safety procedures
* Monitors team schedule
* Assists in maintaining budgets, and exercises control in expense management and facility maintenance
* Promotes company culture and expectations to Team Members
* Oversees proper reporting of inventory
* Serves as MOD as needed
* All additional tasks assigned by management

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 3+ years of experience as an ice resurfacer operator required
* 2+ years of experience in a leadership role in operational management required
* 1 or more years of facility maintenance experience preferred
* Certified Ice Technician (CIT) preferred
* Must be willing to obtain Fire Guard Certification if requested
* Must have excellent interpersonal, project management and problem-solving skills
* Must be a team player
* Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Must have excellent computer skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Must be able to work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays
* Well organized, efficient, flexible, and able to meet deadlines
* Able to cope with many tasks at once and work to tight schedules
* Must possess current CPR/FIRST AID certifications or must be willing to obtain them within a specified period of time

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

* Will be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time
* Must be able to lift 50 pounds waist high
* Must be able to work in cold and inclement weather for prolonged periods of time
* May be required to squat, stoop or bend

new_jobs.title: Clerkship Program Coordinator 2
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Augusta University is Georgia's innovation center for education and health care, training the next generation of innovators, leaders, and healthcare providers in classrooms and clinics on four campuses in Augusta and locations across the state. More than 12,000 students choose Augusta for educational opportunities at the center of Georgia's cybersecurity hub and experiential learning that blends arts and application, humanities, and the health sciences. Augusta is home to Georgia's only public academic health center, where groundbreaking research is creating a healthier, more prosperous Georgia, and world-class clinicians are bringing the medicine of tomorrow to patient care today. Our mission and values https://www.augusta.edu/about/mission.php make Augusta University an institution like no other.

Augusta University's distinct characteristics in education and research include real-world experiences and community engagement, as well as a culture of building community, corporate and government partnerships that address health, security, economic and societal concerns locally and across the state.

The University System of Georgia https://www.usg.edu/hr/orientation/welcome\_to\_the\_board\_of\_regents\_university\_system\_office is comprised of our 26 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards. More details on the USG Statement of Core Values and Code of Conduct are available in USG Board Policy 8.2.18.1.2 and can be found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section8/C224/#p8.2.18\_personnel\_conduct.

Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found online at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653.

**Location**
------------

  

Augusta University

Our Health Sciences Campus: 1120 15th Street, Augusta, GA 30912

Our Summerville Campus: 2500 Walton Way, Augusta, GA 30904

**College/Department Information**
----------------------------------

  

The Medical College of Georgia is one of the nation's largest medical schools by class size, with 260 students per class. The educational experience is anchored by the main campus in Augusta, regional clinical campuses for third- and fourth-year students across the state and a second four-year campus in Athens in partnership with the University of Georgia. MCG's expanding partnerships with physicians and hospitals across Georgia currently provides about 350 sites where students can experience the full spectrum of medicine, from complex care hospitals to small-town solo practices. MCG and its teaching hospitals also provide postgraduate education to more than 500 residents and fellows in 50 different Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education-approved programs. Our researchers and clinicians focus on what most impacts the health of Georgia's and America's children and adults, including cardiovascular biology and disease, cancer, neurosciences and behavioral sciences, public and preventive health, regenerative and reparative medicine, personalized medicine and genomics. Our physician faculty also share their expertise with physicians and patients at about 100 clinics and hospitals statewide.

**Job Summary**
---------------

  

This position assists the Campus Associate Dean in the on-going development and management of the Wellstar regional clinical campus in the areas of regional campus student recruitment, student support services, faculty recruitment, faculty appointments, and regional campus development activities.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

  

The responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Maintain databases of the regional campus, track student assignment student grades into the Banner System periodically.

Create, coordinate and maintain timeline for projects, running concurrent projects in multiple sites.

Develop spreadsheets for regional campus information and maintain matrix of community teaching sites.

Plan regional campus events such as bus tours, campus visits, community outreach, etc.

Act as liaison for SW Campus Deans to increase MCG SW regional brand awareness. Increase number of collaborations with individuals and institutions to further MCG's mission within the region.

Coordinate LIC curriculum, including academic half days, D2L content, student assignments, and grades to ensure comparability in curriculum at direction of LIC Director.

Develop, update and reproduce community faculty development notebooks, including complex maps for campus development and preceptor sites.
