**Account Manager**

**Location: Atlanta Georgia (Remote)**

Swift Workforce AI Inc. is an Atlanta startup founded by Catalyst by Wellstar, the venture and innovation arm of the 13 hospital, ~35,000 employee Wellstar Health System, and Alloy Partners, a leading startup studio. Our mission is to improve work-life balance for the healthcare workforce, starting with nurses, and to improve the financial sustainability of the organizations that employ them. We achieve our mission through Swift™, the first agentic AI copilot for scheduling that autonomously executes complex scheduling and staffing workflows in real-time so providers can do more of what they became providers to do: care for patients. With over 10,000 users, Swift reduces scheduling workflows by more than 80%, increases productivity, and improves work~life balance.

We are seeking an experienced Account Manager that will report to the CEO. In this role you’ll manage current customers and new onboard healthcare systems and and other healthcare delivery organizations. You will be customer-facing and responsible for building and maintaining relationships, eliciting feedback, identifying opportunities, providing customer support, solving problems, and helping close renewal contracts.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Own the Customer Experience:** Lead onboarding and implementation for customers. As part of customer onboarding and management, you will uncover opportunities, often by discovering customer problems, and will act as the liaison between Swift’s technical team and each customer to solve problems an ensure an awesome (!) experience.
* **Be the Go-To Contact:** Act as the primary day-to-day liaison for customer teams, ensuring a responsive, reliable, and consistent experience. You will manage performance reporting for the customer and Swift management.
* **Increase Adoption:** Work with Unit (Nurse) Managers and other leaders to establish and maintain employee awareness of Swift and use of the product.
* **Translate Needs Into Action:** Gather business requirements, rules and constraints and relay them clearly to our technical team to ensure smooth and successful implementations.
* **Lead with Confidence:** Host virtual and in-person meetings, facilitate training sessions, and refine existing onboarding documentation—FAQs, timelines, guides, etc.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Provide regular feedback to the technical and leadership teams based on your insights and learnings.
* **Test the Product:** Perform the Quality Assurance (QA) function for Swift including testing new features, documenting problems, and monitoring (SMS text and email) communications between Swift and end users and responding as needed.
* **Support Sales & Growth:** Assist with sales initiatives, marketing initiatives, reporting, and management functions.

  
**Requirements**  

* You must be live and work in the Greater Atlanta area and can travel regularly to customer sites (primarily in Georgia to start, but nationally as we grow). This may include travel for in-person onboarding sessions at hospitals during off-business hours (e.g. 6:30am, 8pm etc.)
* You have 5+ years of experience as a specialist in implementation and/or customer success for an enterprise technical solution used by hospitals or healthcare delivery organizations.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills and can manage stakeholders from the front line to the C-suite. You are skilled at creating best -practice templates and guides (e.g. Implementation Guide) and can capture and document business requirements captured from customers.
* You love solving problems, managing projects, and adapting in a startup environment that evolves fast.
* You’re comfortable with technology, complexity and a startup environment and capable of navigating in-person meetings at clinical sites.
* You have a high competence level for tools like Microsoft Office, HubSpot, Asana, Clickup, etc. and can quickly learn new systems.
* PMP certification is a big plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive salary + performance bonus + equity participation\*
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Hybrid work model (remote + in-office in Atlanta’s Tech Square)
* A seat at the table in a fast-growing, mission-driven company
* Strong financial backing from investors
* *Subject to successfully completing an evaluation period*

Let’s help the care givers that help so many…

At Swift, your work will directly impact the lives of providers, care teams, and health system financial sustainability. If you’re ready to help us deliver flexible, intelligent solutions to healthcare’s frontline, we want to meet you!

### **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

Swift Workforce AI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All hiring and employment decisions are made on merit, performance, competence, and our business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Department**

BSD SUR - Colon and Rectal: Administration

**About the Department**

The Section of Colon & Rectal Surgery features faculty and staff who tackle complex cases of inflammatory bowel disease, colorectal cancer, diverticulitis and pelvic floor disorders. UChicago Medicine is nationally recognized for our surgeons' expertise in complicated benign and malignant disorders of the colon, rectum and anus. We are at the forefront of surgical innovation and highly skilled in minimally invasive surgical techniques such as advanced laparoscopic surgery, transanal endoscopic microsurgery (TEM), robotic surgery and endoscopic procedures.  
  
The section's educational endeavors focus on training the next generation of colon and rectal surgeons. The colon and rectal surgery fellowship program trains surgeons in the multidisciplinary care of patients with colon and rectal pathologies, provides opportunities for high quality research, and prepares the surgeons for pursuit of academic careers. Fellows can expect a central role in comprehensive multidisciplinary patient management and training in innovative approaches such as robotic surgery and transanal endoscopic microsurgery — the leading edge of colon and rectal surgical care in the 21st century.

**Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator provides professional and administrative support to clinical department management in the Sections of Colon & Rectal Surgery and General Surgery.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently performs high-level administrative duties in support of Section functions. Stays informed of activities relating to programs and initiatives, apprising the faculty of issues when deemed necessary.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the CEO, responsible for managing the CEO’s time, priorities, communications, and logistics while also owning the day-to-day operation of L5’s Chicago office. This role combines high level executive support with hands-on office management and administrative coordination across the business. The ideal candidate anticipates needs before they arise, brings structure to competing demands, exercises sound judgment with highly confidential information, and takes ownership without needing constant direction. It is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with the executive leadership team, human resources, finance, operations, business development, and marketing as well as clients, partners, and board members.

Responsibilities:

**Executive Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the CEO, managing access and prioritizing requests from internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactively manage a complex, fast-moving calendar, resolving conflicts and protecting time for strategic priorities.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including leadership team meetings, client and partner meetings, and board meetings; prepare agendas, briefing materials, and pre-reads, and track follow-up actions to completion.
* Draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, reports, and other materials on behalf of the CEO with a high standard of quality and professionalism.
* Plan and manage domestic travel, including itineraries, site visits to client facilities, conferences, and related logistics; adjust quickly when plans change.
* Process and reconcile the CEO’s expense reports accurately and on time.
* Handle confidential business, client, financial, and personnel information with the utmost discretion.
* Support special projects and executive initiatives, including research, tracking, and coordination across teams.

**Office Operations**

* Own the office environment, creating a welcoming, organized, and professional workplace for employees, clients, and visitors.
* Manage day-to-day office operations, including supplies, mail and deliveries, and general upkeep.
* Serve as the first point of contact for visitors, vendors, and office-related questions.
* Coordinate with building management, landlords, and vendors to resolve facilities issues.
* Plan and coordinate company meetings, leadership offsites, small client dinners, celebrations, and team-building activities, including vendors, logistics, and setup.

**Administrative & People Support**

* Partner with human resources to support onboarding for new hires in the office, including workspace and equipment readiness, first-week scheduling, and introductions.
* Coordinate interview scheduling for executive and office-based roles across candidates and the hiring team.
* Maintain organized, confidential files and records for the executive office.
* Develop and maintain administrative processes, templates, and tools that improve efficiency and consistency as the company grows.

Qualifications:

* 7+ years of experience supporting a C-level executive, with 2 years of office management responsibility preferred; experience in a fast-growing organization a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and shift gears quickly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a polished, professional presence with executives, clients, and board members.
* Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information, including financial and personnel data, with discretion and sound judgment.
* Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented; able to anticipate needs and act independently.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams); ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Flexibility to support occasional needs outside of normal business hours, including some evenings or weekends.
